text: Review your contract. They tried to bill more than $100 more than our reservation but corrected when I pointed it out.

Can get pretty busy in the mornings but that's typical for a donut place. Always eager to help you, they even make sure to have a good variety of donuts fresh in the evening. Nice local place I take my family to from time to time because I know the place is clean and consistent.

Rooms are great, spacious and modern. Staff friendly, great location BUT.....they are attached to sister hotel springhill suites and the signage and getting around is terrible. I'm pretty good navigating around and the facility is hard to figure out. Hope it gets better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: How how how does this place stay in business. The lot is always empty. The food tastes like its been under the warmer for hours.

I love DD coffee & donuts. But this location has the worst service. It's frustrating when the counter person talks to other customers and employees about nothing instead of taking orders. Their sloppy looking and most of them have the personality of a wet rag. To the owner....get involved or get out!!!!
I come here for all my inspections and oil changes. I don't know anything about cars, and they never try to rip me off.
This place is really sketchy, food is more like a snack bar.  Creepy atmosphere. So many good places to eat, don't eat here!
Ordered a maple wood thin crust. Gluten free dough.  Fresh basil was a nice touch. The sausage seemed dry and was not pleased with the crumbly texture.

Like the Dunkin Go 2s but it appears that when I visited the restaurant was understaffed - counter staff will try to keep you waiting using "I will be with you in a moment" as an excuse.  Something to keep in mind if you have to be somewhere on time such as work.
We've been ordering take out since covid started.  Food is just as delicious as when we dined inside.  Highly recommended.

Tea was very good so was the coffee. 
We got the chocolate croissant, and it was very disappointing, barely any chocolate. 
Very nice place to sit though.

The dr. Doses are amazing! Their prices for dental were very reasonable and they were very friendly and thorough with the whole process.  You can tell they really care about the animals and love what they do. I was very comfortable leaving my dog with them for dental work. They have my business for all my pets needs!

Okay food, but they forgot to add fortune cookies. Meal just feel incomplete without it.  I'm guessing they were mad because I ordered at the last Minute but we wanted Chinese and they were the only ones open.  Oh well. Next time I'll ask to please add fortune cookies.

Took me three phone calls and an hour of waiting to get the airport shuttle to come. When he did come, he barely slowed down to give me a chance to hail him down.  Had to call back again. Tried to save a few dollars on the Marriott website - wasn't worth it. I won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
ナッシュビルでの一番本格的な日本料理屋さんです。オーナーさんも日本人です。お菓子とかを販売してる小さなお店もあって、その店のおばぁちゃんはとっても親切で可愛いです
刺身は分厚くて、旨いです。

Used to be a loyal regular but apparently the owner decided to get rid of euro tart so I guess I'll have to jump over to Aspen Leaf instead. I think what irritates me is that he apparently isn't listening to his people on the front lines,  you know, the people that talk to the customers.
The customer service at Dr. Stamper's office is first rate. Every time I go to his office, I am extremely pleased with the staff and the overall experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Best damn burrito (chile relleno, beans cheese and rachero sauce) OMG .... AND so was the chips and salsa ... AMAAAAZING!!! VERY NICE SERVICE TOO !!
Never one to write reviews but this place is the best. Joe always does a good job and remembers what I get every time. Would recommend this place to anyone.
Good, but not great. Tacos are small so get about 4 for a decent lunch. Honestly, El Sitio is much better and is just across the freeway on Calle Real.
Greatt food and frendly staff go there at least once a week they all know me bh now. -------------
Bought cooked shrimp at Seafood Counter last Thursday. Were inedible the next day, spoiled. No wonder they were on sale.
Clean and well appointed. A little on the pricey side but the food is fresh and great quality. They have awesome fried chixken

I've been going here for 5+ years and have never had a bad experience. The staff is really friendly and they always help me pick out frames that honestly look good on my face. I feel like they don't try to oversell me and I genuinely like going here. The optometrist is great and as long as I'm living here I'll go to Glasses Galore.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Different day, different perspective.
Everyone greeted me, was friendly and made eye contact.
I appreciate friendliness.

Some days everyone is smiling and happy you've arrived, and some days they can't wait for the day to end.. I was lucky in that today was a wonderful day for everyone!!

Had the same issue as a couple other reviewers . After using spruce for about a year, one of my shirts came back with a hole in it and another came back with a burn mark. They did not say anything abut it when I picked up the shirts. I will not be going back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Good customer service. However, not impressed at all with the pedicure. The pedicure was short, no attention to my cuticles, and definitely didn't get the good scrub down that you would want with a pedicure. Not sure about their fills/manicures since I was so disappointed with the pedi I just cancelled my fill.
This place is really chill. Everytime we come here we get good service and the food is decent.
Just called and was told they don't offer free estimates. They may be a great shop, but now I'll never know.
Typical but clean friendly location. Location very near the Wilmington Riverfront is a plus. Not much else around.

This is by far the best gym experience I've ever had. The staff is so friendly, Chase and Nicole were so helpful my first time there. The bathrooms have been spotless every time I've been in, and it's always a good mix of people in the gym, a very comfortable setting, not threatening at all.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Had a sick puppy. They got me in within the hour and it was one of the best priced vet visits I have ever paid for! The ladies were all so friendly and even called a few days later to check up on him, I recommend this place to anyone who needs to take their pet to the vet!!!
Whether it's just delivered, hot and fresh, or three days old from the fridge, Dolce Vita Pizza is simply delicious!

It's fine, but it can suck getting into the parking lot because the drive thru line can get backed up all the way to the entrance point on the road.  And getting out can suck too if what you want to do is turn left at the light on Ulmerton.  Just makes the place not worth it.

My family and I have stayed at this location several times and every time was amazing the service is phenomenal .Jayda has really made or stay a great time. She blew me away with her warming personality and kind heart . I look forward to staying here and seeing their beautiful faces !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Second time getting lenses & frames from them & will probably be the last.  Why does it take 4 weeks+ to deliver a pair of glasses?  Tired of the excuses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Best ice cream ever!!! You must stop here at least once while in Nola. Homemade goodness!!
The location is great the food is awesome lots of parking space n it's next to the HWY.
I'm a fan of sport and fitness, and this place is exactly what I need. The equipment is quite good and the staff is nice.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My office for the morning. This Starbucks location is one of the larger ones in the Fishers area. Plenty of seating for both working and socializing.
I love the stylist I have, Jess. She always does a great job and is brilliant with colouring.  I get compliments whatever I go, from women and men alike!

Cancelled our order for no reason after 5ish hours of waiting (and no this does not mean 10 minutes that equal 5 hours - it was hours). Unprofessional and will never order from again. Plenty of other Asian places to order from in Philly. Now I am just hangry because I want food.

Thank you for having a lovely, immersive, and community oriented business. The welcome upon entering was so warm. Even though selection is small it packs a great flavor and taste for any sweet tooth!! Brought the kids along and they loved it as well. The owner is personable and engaging!! My children really appreciated it.
Ice cream is my weakness, and there's is one of my faves! Love all the flavor combos they have and come up with. I've never tried a flavor I haven't liked.
Fast, efficient, and reasonably priced, with amazing service!!! Will definitely be going back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I started a 6 week challenge here and have been pleased with the support from trainers on how to do moves as well as modifications. I've always felt welcomed as a newcomer and also have all the equipment you need to do your workout.  Nothing fancy but a great place to work out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: They have a great selection of beers with plenty of craft beers.  Cozy atmosphere with pool tables and T.V.'s to keep you entertained.
The food is good but service and management is terrible. Always disappointing on available items and they close before there advertised time.
Place is a dump... bathrooms were really gross! It is cash only !! food okay

Ok Gym... Takes forever to get anything repaired. Gym usually clean... Ok staff depending on day.. Only 2 stair climbers so when one is broke its pretty dumb.. Staff could care less.. Doesn't seem like much management expertise at this location.  Will be switching after the year.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My favorite for frozen yogurt! Creamy. Nice range of flavors, but I love the vanilla and chocolate swirl. Topped with kiwi and raspberries! This location just reopened, they had closed for the winter. Happy they are back, and hard to beat the price, 25 cents an ounce on Thursday.

I've been banking here for a number of years. Right now they're not busy at all, but I've been sitting in the drive thru to cash a check, and they recieved the check and my License, but still haven't even greeted me after 15 minutes of waiting. I get so frustrated at this place.
Happy cow makes me a happy girl. I come for the salted caramel yogurt/ice cream. Definitely a treat when my sweet tooth kicks in

I special ordered 8 cases of Grolsch 15.2 flip tops and got for 7.99 a 4 pack 51 cents under Win Dixie as I am a home brewer and the flip top are great but the down side is they usually sell for about 2 dollars a bottle so basically I got the beer for free

The wifi RARELY works and most of the machines (bike, treadmills, ellipticals, cybex's) are frequently in need of maintenance. For instance, right now all four bikes are having major pedal problems. 

But it's only $10/$20 a month, the staff are all very nice, and it's close to my house and work.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Fabulous. We had Kung pao shrimp and vegetable lo mein, with lots of left overs. Very fast service and easily the best Chinese in the area.

This is a good spot in Lakeview. The bartenders are very friendly and professional. Afternoons tends to be a local crowd but later the young people show up and it has energy. Friday's are great because they have crawfish! Don't really have a complaint. Just a really good neighborhood spot.

The food is great, BUT THERE IS NO ENGLISH MENU and they ONLY TAKE CASH! Being a Mandarin-speaker just isn't enough, because you have to read the menu. Don't try asking the lady for the most popular dishes, cuz she'll cut you with her eyes. This hole-in-the-wall would receive a lower rating if not for the tasty food.

Donuts are fine but the service here is very subpar.  The employees are slow and not well trained.  We ordered chocolate frosted long john donuts and they threw it into a bag which caused the chocolate to be smeared all over the place. They need to hire people with common sense.
We went to get two chocolate frostys instead we got nothing and the employees thought it was a joke  and laughed in our faces
This was pretty generic sushi. The cooked menu looked good though. Nice perks with the complimentary soup and ice cream
Unproffesional employees as I already expected anyways. Place wasnt clean they are too busy talking and having fun.
Great gym, great staff! They just got a bunch of new equipment. Very clean. Great trainers that work there.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Nice convenience store with hot food you can order. Pretty popular it seems and with small parking lot, you must be quick. Order through phone and pick up open until 9:30 or 10. Support your local business, I like this kind of store. Perfect for single guys.

Very nice place. Came without reservation, ate at the bar. One very rare restaurant where you can eat an appetizer, an entree and a dessert without being too loaded. The cuisine is fine, well elaborated and in the same time simple. An actual good combination of taste and texture. Love it!

MAC's is pretty straight forward. They offer different levels of washes ($4-$12 in range). Pull up, put car in neutral, pick your wash, pay, and when it comes out you get a soft cloth dry. It's not the most detailed wash, but hey it's convenient and it gets the job done.

I've been to Lissa Ellison a couple times now since I moved to St. Louis and have left happy every time. On my second visit I asked for a skin fade and she got right to work and pulled me together right away.  Easy to schedule and takes her cuts seriously.

Paid $15 for the "second highest" car wash, it didn't even get the bird poop of my side and back window. I feel like the "scrubbing cloth" didn't even really touch my car and your car goes so fast through the wash that you honestly feel like it's not even doing anything expect getting it wet.

This is the best play for glasses. They know what they doing. They fit my youngest child amazing.(no one else has been able too. So so amazing. Oh and my husband has glaucoma and has many issue with glasses but they had him cover to so not only for little kids but all kids.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Fantastic service, I love this place! I come here every once in a while to indulge in my sushi cravings. It's on the pricey side but the meal options are generous. The guys are so nice about explaining the sushi options, what's in them and how it's made. And I definitely appreciate the buy two get one free Wednesday option!

Great service and delicious food. I came in late on a Saturday by myself. Got seated right away and ordered a margarita on the rocks. Dinner bread was also tasty. I only ate once slice. (Saved room for dessert)

Ordered veal entree and coconut cream cake for dessert. Also a cup of coffee. 

I over ate but it was worth it.
Ice cream is horrible and the way they've set up the ordering system is weird. I've o logo e twice, but never again.

Signed up for the monthly CarWash package, went today for the 1st time. Super Nice location, the car wash and amenities were well worth it ! Some issues with the entrance and exits. All new construction over there, it should be nice once it's all built out. ‍
I just moved to Jersey and I need a place to trim my beard. This will be my go to place. The girl did an amazing job.
Good food. Good staff. The dirve thru is really messed up. The store isn't the cleanest but its normal for a fast food place

Too cold in the summer.  My family stayed here on 5/30 and it was hot out and freezing in our room.  The front desk said the heat is turns off when it reaches a certain temperature outside.  This means all you can get is cold air.  If you are not a big fan of too much AC like my family you will not enjoy your nights here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location is always slow, and is especially slow to pick up passengers- waited over 20 minutes after calling ahead of time. If possible- try to avoid.
If there is a Burger King in the world, that is worst than this one, I have yet to experience it. How are they still in business?
Great frozen yogurt! Only outdoor seating. Little parking, driving thru.

Left a bad taste in my mouth.  One clerk was bad mouthing my road insurance for a significant delay, while I am hearing a listing of actions from my insurance listing who they talked to and when!?!  

They got it done in 1.5 hours.  But I could do without the drama and difficulty.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Incredibly slow service, impossible to get a loan, however they do have extended hours and they are always open. That's the only reason that I bank here.

These guys used to be good about 10 years ago, but more recently when I brought my Mustang in for an alignment after some suspension mods, the tech tried to coerce me into paying him to replace my lower control arm bushings.  Having built up a dozen or so Mustangs, I called BS and took my car elsewhere, never to return.

My brother and dad started coming here in the early 2000's and I have been bringing my son here since he's been 9mo. old, he's 5 now. Humphrey is an incredible, humble person with a great personality. He has such loyal customers and has made great friendships. Great customer service and awesome haircuts at affordable prices!

I'm impressed. The room is nice. The linens are nice. The beds are comfy. The manager is on top of everything! 

The breakfast is on point. Scrambled eggs, potatoes O'Brien, bacon, doughnuts, pastries, bagels, regular and cinnamon waffles, big and small waffle griddles, yougurt, and 2 kinds of cereal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Jeni is fun work for and her staff has the smiles on their faces to prove it.  I was so impressed with their attitude and willingness to help that the ice cream could have not even been good (which it is delicious) and I wouldn't have noticed.  Creative flavors and smiling staff makes this place a "must" in Nashville!
Delicious chicken burrito w cheese! My first time here. I will go back again. Very close to home and convenient.
Great Italian and great decor. Friendly service. Nice bar to eat at . Get the seafood hot appetizer.
Im here right now and love the way i was greet at this restaurant , the cashier Beatriz VA was very friendly

The food was great, the service was questionable.  The waitress forgot O ordered soup not salad.  I got salad but it was a quick fix.  She exchanged it but when she carries the bowl of soup, her thumb wad in it!  Other than that, the pork kastu don was great. Get the tempura appetizer!

John is absolutely the best mechanic anyone can ask for.  As a single gal, it can be hard to find a mechanic you can trust. You can trust John. He truly cares about your car (it's his patient!) and you!
I'm grateful that a friend referred me to him and that my search for someone to help me maintain my 2013 Honda Civic is over!

I recently stayed there for 4 days...and I will DEFINITELY be staying there again. The location is perfect! The staff was perfect!! The room was like a cute little apt. Really enjoyed my stay and the bed was so comfy!!  If you're looking for a cozy/safe place to stay in the French quarter. This is the place!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Not a third wave coffee place. This rating is for the atmosphere and availability of cold drinks, iced cream ... 
coffee was fine, but not third wave.
I ordered a cold brew coffee. Instead I got a tiny bit of coffee and like a cup of half and half. I don't think the employee knew what he was doing.
As a Starbucks lover, I had a hard time making the switch over but I love DD new app and this one has the friendliest staff, and always fast service!!
worst sandwich I've ever had and not real nice people.  My sandwich had no mayo and tons of pepper, like that's all I tasted.
Man this windixie is a part of my life! Great deli and liquor!!
Susan Rumble, the general manager was very rude and unprofessional. Horrible customer service!

I was happy to see Debbie open this! Great location and interior is lovely. But Debbie is the jewel here. Totally professional, gave me a beautiful cut. I was nervous because switching stylists is kinda' risky. But she listened carefully to what I wanted, and took a lot of care with me. Thank you, Debbie!

Lions Choice is back in Illinois!  And my first visit today (at the old Tim Hortons location) was worthy!  Awesome, tender roast beef, wonderful fries, and a dipped cone. What could be better!?   Welcome back ... feel the ROAR!  Oh ... and it's got the coolest dining room AND IT SERVES BREAKFAST!!!
The prices were reasonable, and loved the free vacuums. The wash leaves a few streaks so make sure you bring a towel to complete the job! I'll be back!
Right up the road from Nashville and a very easy commute.  The suites are huge! Great re-do of the lobby and rest of the hotel. I recommend  it highly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They take their time with each one of their clients and are very thoughtful and accurate with what they do. Troy and Trina are the nicest

For an airport spot it hit the void. I gave it 5 because it has perfect view, charging station at every seat and the server came around often to check on me. 
It's an airport. Look for something to fill your void and know it's NOT gonna be cheap! $15 for a double cranberry vodka. But worth it for my travel!
Horrible!!! My sisters-in-law ordered a custom cake and they did not have but sold her another that tasted old!!! For $30!!!
This is probably my least favorite place I have ever been. Extremely unhelpful. Bank somewhere else especially for a business acct.

I LOVE PETRINIS! Their seafood pasta is to die for. That's my first pick on the menu and am slowly trying other dishes. I have yet to be disappointed, everything is straight fire. Pork chops, bruschetta risotto, garlic bread, seafood pasta... can't go wrong. Happy to have been introduced to this restaurant.
Fantastic atmosphere, cuisine, and service!!  I highly recommend this restaurant if you are looking for an experience.
Great customer service and they price match!! Wait times are a bit inconvenient and this location is in an odd spot, making it chaotic to get in and out of.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Horrible. I got the top of the line package and the gal doing the car, daughter of the front desk wan, told me point blank that my car had too much trash and - next time - they wouldn't clean it out. 
No coffee and the place is always empty and dirty. 
Guess what there will never be a next time.

Has got to have the worst produce of any grocery store I've been too. This place certainly doesn't take pride in the cleanliness of its most perishable product. 
When asked if they have any additional produce in the back I was informed that the guy was on break and couldn't be bothered. 

Poor excuse for a grocery store.
great inexpensive lunch! the burgers and fries are great and my coworker raves over the omelets.  the catch, they except cash only!

This is the WORST dealership on the planet. If you are considering buying a Chevy, and this is your only option for dealerships, then do not buy a Chevy.  They honestly spoil the Chevrolet name.  Horrible service, horrible communicators, horrible quality, absolutely the worst in every way.

Staff are awesome and are efficient at what they do best! I've never had a poor drink from this location. 

The cafe is usually pretty full, as is the outdoor seating. I see a lot of regulars here on a daily basis. The cafe is in good order, and the condiment bar is well kept considering how busy this location is.

I've been going to fresh market for years. It's a wonderful place to shop. The prices are a bit steep, but I love all the specialty meats and the wine selection. The service is always really good, staff friendly. The broasted chicken is one of the best I've ever tasted.
Come here about once a month with the bf. Always good. Always pretty quick. I love that I can make my own veggie roll.

Had an appointment at 130pm.. they told me they will be with me shortly. Well an hour later they took my car back, as it's up on the lift thingy the 2 mechanics start arguing and screaming at eachother. Now another 30 mins I'm sitting here waiting for my oil change to be finished. Safe to say I will never be returning
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I moved from Seattle to Tampa and i found Sun Nails Ty is awesome i really love my nails thank you so much.
Thrifty Rental is the worst ran business. I will NEVER rent from them again! Waited two hours just to get a basic car pathetic!!

Excellent sushi!  I loved it. Very fresh. Very kind staff. It is definitely BYOB. 

I will for sure come back. Awesome!

Clean, convenient and with ample machines and room.

Now, have to work with a trainer or take a class for a fuller review.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Drive thru usually pretty congested & slow but staff is ALWAYS friendly:). Buy one get one free salted caramel mochas today!

I was just traveling through and stopped to workout plus take a shower. Front desk staff was really nice and checkin was a breeze. The place was clean and the equipment all worked. The showers and locker were really nice. No complaints if I was local I would join there
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This restaurant is a hidden Gem!  The lump crab chowder is to die for and you have to stop in for breakfast.  We love the egg white omelette.

Awesome hotel to stay at.
Located directly inside the Tampa airport so was incredibly convenient to fly out of with two small children the following morning.
Rooms were as clean as could be, staff was more than friendly, and room service came on time in the morning, hot and very good quality.
Would def reccomend staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been holding back, been a member for 3 years. My biggest complaint is the wifi. If there is no one in the gym it is average, more than 10 people what is wifi. Nothing in the free weight area. This is after they upgrade the equipment. I use an iPhone 6s, so this should offer more insight.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Service is okay. Came for restaurant week but did not think the amount of food was worth it.
Cleanly, good service....but place is too cheap to accept coupons or even offer the specials being ran by subway as a whole....no thanks.
We only get oatmeals, raspberry cheesecake pies, and iced tea from here. Quality was great, but small portions. Service was on point!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Carrie does a fabulous job with my highlights and cut. Great attention to detail. Highly recommend!
One of the few reasonable Barber shops in Rittenhouse. I'm been pretty happy with my experiences so far, and plan to keep coming back.
Outstanding extra effort, personal care and quick problem solving by their professional staff made my trip much, much more enjoyable!

Everyone at Berry Farms eyecare is so professional , knowledgeable, courteous and efficient.   I never have to wait. All my questions and concerns are answered. Dr. Crim is very patient and takes the time with you to make sure you are satisfied before you leave.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Showed up 2 and a half hours before their listed closing time and they had already locked the doors for the evening. We had driven 35 minutes to meet friends there and were not pleased that they wouldn't let us in, when it was clearly listed online that they should still be open. Will not be returning.

Very nice people, but poor knowledge of anything other than simple banking needs. Wasted a lot of time getting there, waited on them, and didn't have a resolution in the end. Had to drive over to the Brentwood location to get what I needed, wasted my morning. Hopefully this location gets some more finance courses ASAP.

Old building & carpet, definitely needs to remodel. Small rooms. Smelly hallways. No breakfast/coffee/cookies like any other hotel charging $140/night. Wi-fi is extremely slow. When my room was cleaned I didn't get any amenities re-stocked.

Received 2 stars because they have a great gym and the staff is friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The cashier was extremely rude and and refused to help us when our corporate cards chip didn't work. She said she didn't know what to do and refused to help. I was after I told her we would go somewhere else, she stepped up to help. How rude. I won't return to this Starbucks again.

If I want to get pizza delivered from Royal I have to get it from the west end location. It's never as good as when I pick up and get it from the Hamptons location. Always inconsistent with their quality. Last night I ordered and barely any sauce on the pizza and undercooked. From now on I will just pick up from the Hamptons!

This location is friendly and fast. I have called for help ordering though Postmates and they were very helpful. They are busy so do tend to run out of some types of dounuts so they are not always my first choice as far as DD locations but thier drive through is fast.
Took my money twice, no phone number is listed on anything to call and get it back. Machine would have me pull up blink stop and then back and then shut off

Another too much of a good thing. These donuts are actually more  like cakes, in texture and size. I love the creativity of the toppings but for me they would be better on a real donut, size and texture. Of course the kids love them and they are fun to look at.
Great prices, good service.They serve all walks ins as if you were a regular One of the rare gems in Edmonton
I had veggie sandwich and it was so good! I didn't even crave for meet!

This place is right off the beaten path. Seems to be a nice place to drink, dance and meet people.

We stopped in for a night cap and the people were still flooding in.

They have security at the entrance, for checking IDs and handling any issues that may arise in the later evening.
There's a reason this place is only open until 2pm.  The service is slow.  Orders often come out not together.  Or incorrectly.
Delicious ice cream. No sprinkles but ice cream was yummy! Staff was friendly and efficient.
Santos has always been helpful and reliable for all of my cars. I wouldn't use anyone else in the city .

A fine place. Perfectly clean and quiet. Only complaint is they have a crappy Continental breakfast and charge you $17 for it. I opted out of that and went to Panera across the street. It's ok the charge for breakfast but if you're gonna charge $17 you should probably at least make it real.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They have an average review on here of 2 stars. I wouldn't give them more than 1. They are so understaffed. Long line to see someone about the most basic things. I've been here many times over the last 3 years and each time it's the same thing. I hate this branch.

Enterprise had Melissa in customer service reach out with an apology July 5th and a promise the regional management team, that oversees the Florrisant location, would be contacting me to address the unsatisfactory level of service. So far that has not happened. Guess my time and money is not important to them.‍
Great time. Nice piano artist!!! My wife loves the shot chair. We both got the special take home cup drinks. Amazing time!!!!
I called to get a price on getting a flat fixed $35.99WTH! Is this price legal... Smdh in a city where they don't EVEN pay livable wages.... #tragic ..smdh

Loved eating here! Food and service were muy bueno. ( very good). This is a New Port Richey on highway 19. My co-worker got the tortilla soup and raved about it. For inexpensive Mexican food, we shall return. My tacos were great. Chips and salsa were right on par.

Came here because of the Axxess card and was very happy with the food and service. I would go around lunch time because the dinner menu is more expensive but the portions arent that much bigger.

The Japanese Pumpkin Ravioli w/ reduced balsamic sauce is the best!

Far and away, the best bar on the Wilmington riverfront.  Kelly was one of the coolest bartenders we ever met.  Honestly, the other guys were really salcking, but Kelly more than made up for it.  Highly recommend.  No pretentious nonsense, just good deals and good times.
I loved the flute playing n it really took me to another place I love ritz Carlton and felt like I was very special.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ridicously slow kitchen! Becoming habitually slow! This used to be our favorite  choice but this service has changed our opinion
Hotel needs major remodel. Not clean, curtains filthy, wallpaper falling off. Close to airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in thinking it would be like a typical barbershop. Quick in and out without much of a second thought at their work. Man I was wrong. These dudes take big pride in their work and craft. Great service and atmosphere and all around cool guys. Book with Steve next time you go
I just wanted to thank you for the food poisoning I had from ordering from you guys truly enjoyed that!
workers with nasty attitudes who threaten to fight kids for pulling into the parking lot to check and see if they're open.

Got lucky and got a table on a Friday night and got treated to one of the best Italian meals I've ever had. I got the "Sunday gravy" which was fantastic. The meatballs and the braised meat were some of the best I've had. My gf got the gnocchi which was heaven in every bite.

So happy we happened to go here.

When I am at Lowes...I must admit this is often where I wind up.
Consistant quality in my experience regardless of which location you find yourself neer.
Not the best burger bar. Not the worst. Thanks to their franchising efforts...there always seems to be one not too far away!
One order of fries will feed several diners!

This place is nice~however it is almost double the price of any other vet in SB. Have very very deep pockets if you want to go here. They charged me $30 to clip my dogs nails and other prices are almost twice as much as other vets! I now go to San Roque Pet Hospital and they are very friendly and very reasonable!

I've owned 8 pets over 4 decades now and my experiences at Dr. Kathy's have all been excellent.

The doctor and her staff are knowledgeable, efficient, thorough, and patient.

Their prices are also very reasonable.

I am very lucky to have such quality of vet care nearby.
Typical Aldi, no frills, good pricing but at times produce can be sketchy.

Stay away from these people.  They sold out and lost their general Manager as he took all their mechanics with him to Big O tire.  These people are rude with no knowledge and greedy.  I wouldn't take a tire up there.  They act like you are doing them a favor and have lost almost all their business.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It's Arby's and it's finally open!  They've only been open a few hours so couldn't miss my chance to be the first to review and put them on the map!  The 2 for $6 French dip and swiss met all tasty expectations!  Modern interior and a great location that needed more options and super easy to get to from I-10.

I got a cut here on Wednesday. The guy that did my cut spoke very little English but he gave me exactly what I showed him in the photo. Also when they wash your hair they add a massage in and they wash it three times. Over all it was so relaxing and exactly what I wanted in terms of the look. It's $25 for long hair.

Not enthused about my stay here. The lighting is fluorescent and cold, the carpet is dingy, and there is rust in the bathroom. Also, why is the sink outside of the bathroom??? Would not recommend this as a place to stay - go to the Airport Marriott if you need a place close to the Airport in Nashville!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Excellent customer service, friendly and courteous staff! Great food! Highly recommend this location to everyone!

Vet and staff take extra time to explain pricing and services.  Vet was able to do blood work and schedule surgery within one day.  She even called before surgery to be sure that I was comfortable with the procedure. No pressure and very compassionate.  One of my best vet experiences.
Great price for a basic wash. Did a great job and they were quick.
The bar is super nice in a retro kinda way. Didn't eat but the bar alone is worth coming in for a drink

It's good. Nothing to write home about but good. It's hard to find an exceptional takeout Chinese food around Mad Beach area. But this place is good. Had the house fried rice, raggon, bourbon chicken, shrimp and veggies. For a quick drive by for a Chinese food fix, it's good.

It's not the best hotel you can stay in.  Items left in the room after check out seem to magically disappear because retrieval isn't happening. The restaurant there is awful so make sure you get out to experience good food. It definitely won't happen at Crabby Bill's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Awesome place to go eat with the family! Great pies!! I highly recommend coming here when your in town. The service was excellent and the prices are decent as well. The restaurant is very clean and I caught a glimpse of the kitchen. It looked very clean! Just go!!!
Spent $8.11 for a double cheeseburger, fries, and a mini shake. The fries had no taste and were cold. I hate cold fries.

I had a very good experience at Dobbs. The guys working the front desk were very nice and helpful. I bought four new tires from them. I cant say they had the lowest price but I wanted service that day. They ordered the tires from another store and had be going in about an hour. I'll be back for sure.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Fast and friendly. They squeezed  me in at the end of the day and helped me with a tire emergency
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: They allow people with domestic violence history to live here and get into fist fights. This changed over the past year. I guess they decided to loosen their requirements of who can live here and several of our new neighbors have been having domestic violence issues. I've had to call the cops four times over the past year.

Felicias is our favorite place for Pizza. I'd avoid the Margarita (No fresh Basil) , but other than that everything on the menu is fantastic. Remember to get a salad and bring a bottle of wine to the roofdeck. I can't believe I lived near Ardmore for three years before finding Felicias. 

Wonderful!
Love Steven.. I cut my hair at Eagle for many years. Best shampoo and massage experience in Philly. Prices are very inexpensive. I recommend
Shrimp pasta was delicious.. delivery was hot and prompt. Chicken tenders were worth it. We will order from there again.

I won't shop any other store unless I'm too far away.  Full line of all beverages, and the best prices around, if not lower, for sure they won't be higher.  Quick check out, and great customer service if you're looking for a specific bottle.   Always have a positive experience here.
This shop has a cool vibe with exceptional barbers. Miguel got mad skillz. If you in the area check out KleenKut Barbershop.

I think the doctors and staff are great. My husband, five year old, and I go here. My 3 star rating is for the fact that glasses take 10 business days to make. That's just unreal. So if you want to wait over two weeks to fill your prescriptions, by all means use them. Otherwise, take the scrip elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Upscale, very nice place to stay, a lil expensive, but you get what you pay for. Valet parking is nice to use. Downtown and near everything, just a short walk away. Comfy beds, lots of pillows, good friendly service. All around nice place to stay when away from home.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Thick pan pizza halfway cooked.  My kids even tossed their pieces.  Not one full piece got eaten.  The time before this I waited 15 minutes for a hot and ready.  this time Hot ready pizza were fine. I enjoy their pizza but this branch must have an internal employee issue to not be able to put out a consistent product.
well I spoke to soon the credit came through today but they used my money for over 10 days
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: A nice little neighborhood grocery market that also has a decent deli with meat and three plates.  They actually have parking which makes it easy to do some quick shopping for needed items.  Martin's BBQ also has one of their locations right next door so you can combine making groceries  and a BBQ stop all in one.

Fabulous European frames that you won't find in generic eye glass places like LensCrafters or Pearl vision.  A wee bit pricey --- but for a great look, excellent customer service --- aren't you worth it?
Staff is meticulous making sure frame suits your face & your lifestyle.  You deserve it!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: they took me as a walk-in, contact and glasses exam, done in under 40 minutes.  decent glasses selection and mine were ready the next day.  only criticisms would be the generally chaotic situation at the front desk and how run-down the exam room was.  but all in all a good experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Yelp says this place opens at 9AM on a Saturday. I showed up at 9:30, and... it was closed. Now, I'd blame Yelp for this, but the sign in the window on the door clearly says that the place actually opens at 8 on Saturdays, yet it still was not open. I won't be wasting any more time trying to figure out when they're actually open.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Hours are not correct, as when we stopped at 3pm today they were closed. Also, phone number listed has been disconnected.

It has its shortcomings.
But finding a grocery store on the edge of the city was a blessing.
Nice people inside.

Good service and decent coffee for $2.75. This was a very busy place around noon. If you are looking for a place to study or get work done a lot of people clearly enjoyed doing it here. I found it to be a somewhat distracting environment that would hinder my productivity but I enjoyed chatting over a cup of coffee on the couch.
A lot of sushi restaurants have opened over the last 10 years, but Sakura is still the best! Don't be fooled by its modest decor,...it's excellent!
Dr Masso is Awesome!  Great new facility.  Great staff.  Always treated with respect and great care for my dogs.
This place is my fav bar in the neighborhood. The bartenders are awesome so welcoming and polite. Food is really good at perfect prices. Just a solid bar.
Worst experience even for a Chinese Restaurant. No Lomain noodles, $2.00 for a pot of Tea, Chow Mein worse than canned.   Their main course was "Slop Suey"

If i had known there was a pool i'd of brought my swimsuit! It's no "W" but on a budget you can have a nice romantic stay smack in the middle of the city. There is a cool view out front of some rose garden as an added bonus. I'd say do it, unless money isn't an issue.

text: I ordered at the drive through and the service was good & I asked to use the rest room. She warmly said yes that's fine. When I entered I was startled by a rude male employee walking towards me yelling that they're dinning area was closed. I felt like I committed a crime & not that I supported the establishment.

This place is in the middle of the ghetto. Their beer selection is mostly colt 45 and other "40s". No craft beer and very little outside of colors light, bud ice, etc... I don't understand any of these reviews. Liquor selection is not that great and I did not feel welcomed in this part of town.
Awesome food 99% awesome service (had one night with a trainee that wasn't stellar) but otherwise absolutely love this place. Get the wings!!!!

Went there around 3pm today and the service was fast but when I got my food is was barely lukewarm at best  I had to microwave it just to make it edible . This place goes through phases where one month it's really good then they go to shit and I blame them solely hiring work release workers

Friendly staff.
Clean room.
Comfy bed and pillows.
Nice shower head and shower pressure.
Nice breakfast buffet. Breakfast suggestion: More low-carb and fresh items; only ate eggs, sausage & fruit for this reason. Lots of starch/gluten used.
Internet was touchy at first but pulled through.
I would stay here again and recommend.

text: Cute place with great flavor options!! Cash only!! Staff was very friendly and patient
Delicious coffee and amazing pastries! I've had fruit tarts and blueberry tarts and croissants, it's all fantastic!
Andrew gave 10/10 service. And if you want a good drink that comes with a good time get the shark attack
My favorite cheesesteak in town.  Addicted to the buffalo chicken pizza.
Yeah, so happy to be back. Service is good. Great people at this branch and management have made improvements.
As Subways go, this is a good one.  The line looks long, but they really work fast here.
Posted on Facebook - "Closing as of dinner on 11/23 to consider other options". Sorry to see it close-I really enjoyed their food.

These guys are great!  Their service was prompt, fairly-priced, and pleasant. While the facility may not be the most fancy, their prices reflect the lower overhead.  

I will definitely return when needed. A strong reccommend for honest, competent & fair-priced service.

The experience and help from the staff is always professional the past two times I've visited. But wait  3rd visit was different when I was given Dr.K. She was rude and never contacted back although she said she would. I don't recommend this place even if it's the last animal hospital during a pandemic
I found this hotel to be very comfortable and the staff extremely friendly. No complaints regarding my stay here.

text: I've been bringing my shirts / suits to this place for more than a year - always impeccable, timely, and reasonably priced. Awesome customer service - I'm often tight on schedule as I travel a lot, but I've always got my stuff back on time (and the owner even follows up with me on my cell on a regular basis!)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Went for lunch. Been awhile. Had menudo and shredded beef tacos. Excellent. Service was good. Ample parking. Have always enjoyed eating here.
Dirty...service just okay, fish cuts alright...not a place to bring a date but good for lunch time I guess.
Love it! Sometimes the people there are more worried about socializing with each other or visiting friends. Other than that, the product is great!

I wouldn't give them one star.  I made a reservation for them to pick me up at progressive service center. They messed up and had me picking up at the page location. I was told I would have to wait 90 minutes. I never received a coupon or anything. I had to rent from Enterprise which I hate.
Convient for after work or lunch run. Small but always stocked.
I love this store but the bakery dept ladies are never nice . They are always rude.

Yogurt is fine, typical you'd find at this type of place, but prices are insane. $40 for 4 treats, most less than 1/4 full .. I've never spent more than $20 for similar. We won't be back. 

Suggestion - get Frostys across the street at Wendy's for 1/8 the price.
Expensive! Also, the category says this place has wine and spirits, it only has beer.
The drinks were good. But when you order and are charged for a venti I also expect the cup to be filled more then half way.

I sent my husband here for his birthday and he came back mutilated.  I was angry that he paid for his shave.  His face was literally bleeding in 7 places and more razorburn than I've ever seen.  The owner gave his service as well.  

It was absolutely unacceptable and they should have been profusely apologetic.
Class schedule met my needs but the yoga studio is pretty noisy sometime ( from the sound of upstairs).

text:
friendliest staff evah! (w/ 1 exception lol). 
outdoor seating in the sun and w/ street noise.
wifi weak outside.

It's a lovely place to live except people like to pull the fire alarm in the building in the middle of the night causing everyone to evacuate about once every two months. Nobody is ever prosecuted, so it happens again and again and again.

Other than that, it's a quiet place to live.
Rick is an honest and very knowledgeable technician.  I trust him with my vehicles and he has never let me down.  Highly recommend!

So you will charge $15-20 to do the nails of my 3yr old but you can't get one of these teenyboppers that work there to dust the vents in the bathroom?  Nasty af.  When you call "pull off the dust like it's monkey bread", you haven't cleaned it in far too long...
High quality, excellent service for moderate prices. Consistently the best "special occasion" restaurant in Tucson.

Dustin did a fantastic job cutting my hair. He was super nice and we had a good conversation. Sometimes it can be that awkward obligatory conversation with a new barber, but Dustin was super cool and easy to talk to. His cut was great and the price was right!
I've only had good experiences when visiting this branch. Have been impressed with their customer service and feel that should be noted!

First time here and was surprised. The place is so,hidden and right next to a junkie gas station but is really cute inside and has amazing food. The chips and salsa was addicting! I got the enchilada meal with ground beef and is was plate licking good. Really fair prices. Will definitely come back.

This is a GREAT place, small with a cool atmosphere. I loved the chicken curry press box, will be back for more SOON.

Heads up, they do take-out but some reason don't have a take-out menu... No idea why, management if you're reading this, post a take-out menu for hungry Yelpers like myself!

Three Stars is being generous. My husband and I ordered hibachi and sushi. Sushi was OKAY, the slices were pretty thin. My hibachi came out COLD, drenched in sauce and my steak was WELLLL done (when I asked for medium rare). Don't waste your time here, go across the street to Sakura.
Horrible experience putting our precious lab to sleep. If there was a no star option I would have rated it that.
Sam wok never fails me. They are the best chinese food spot in Edmonton. Their salted fish fried rice.......YUMMMMMMM
Fair, reasonable rates. One of the workers has been there for awhile, and she is easy to work with. Quick turn around with clothes.

text: OMG - loved this place. Intuitive and wonderful.  Great layout, beautiful look, awesome rain shower.  close to neat places. lovely staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The special line for the unlimited pass is always having mechanical problems. The whole point of that line is so that it can get the customers in and out. Absolutely pointless when it doesn't work. Why am I waiting 5 to 10 minutes to get my car washed? Looking forward to the grand opening of the new one in Speedway.

Pizza and garlic knots are very good, but as much as the family running the place is nice, they really need to work on their other menu offerings. Had the lasagne and hubby the spaghetti and meatballs with a salad. They were bland and it was the thinnest, most lackluster lasagna I've ever had.
Not a great experience.  Our room was extremely hot and the bathroom was very outdated.  We used points for our stay and would not stay there again.

text: Great location. Ball park is walking distance. Parking is the biggest problem. Rooms are nice with great views.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Way overpriced for what it was. I ordered broiled grouper. Fish was fried. And not very fresh.

Stayed here when I came down for a weekend with my husband. The place is well kept, clean and modern looking. We had a set of French doors leading to the veranda on our floor which was nice. I liked the fact it was in walking distance of all the bars and activity in the French quarter. I would recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Check the dates!! These folks know how to put a case of beer on the shelf but struggle to understand good beer doesn't keep as long as the cheap stuff they spent the last decade selling. Also, the cashier needs to question whether her personality is appropriate for a front-of-house position.

Wow, overpriced and underwhelmed.  Almost $60.00 for two large pizzas and three salads, which contained plenty of iceberg lettuce.  One pizza was not even cooked enough, and was pretty skimpy on the toppings.  I"d rather have Pizzahut over this overpriced pie!
Fair prices, owner and employees are super friendly. They also get your clothes cleaned on time and always in perfect condition.

text: This is a Great ice cream spot but special occasions only kids scoop almost 3 dollars I don't think so!
Enjoyed the rice, chicken tacos and burritos. Service is average. Great place to sit outside and eat on a nice day. I will return.

Seems like a very nice laundry with very nice staff. But contrary to an earlier review is NOT a dry cleaner.  I'm leaving the 5* rating because I have no reason to downgrade them.  I just wanted to correct the record so that someone else doesn't go there seeking a dry cleaner.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: No frills liquor store. Wine prices are much cheaper than other stores. You can always find bottles for $3.99! Massive variety of nips(little liquor bottles) for a dollar or 2. Beer and liquor prices are much higher than other stores ive been to and about a $3-4 difference. 6 packs and cases available.
Great food and service for the price compared to other steak houses. When go to the movie next door we always eat here. The prime rib is always delicious.
We went for a 5 course pre fixe NYE special and it was delicious! All the dishes were unique, fresh and tasty. Not to mention the glorious cocktails.
The name of this restaurant is accurate - it is tasty and it is a place. It's a weird place, but it's a good place. Go to it.
Awesome service. John and andy are great! Very fast and friendly. I do recommend setting up an appointment in advance

text: Open 24 hours, but not 24 hours in a ROW!!!  Run, leave skid marks, and don't look back.

text: This is the best barber shop that I have been to. The barbers are all really nice and cut hair good. They do great cutting women's hair.

So they've raised their prices to $3.25 (single), $3.75 (double) and $5 (triple), though dryers have stayed the same. I'm taking now giving them 3 stars though I'll probably continue to go there because it IS clean and IS convenient to where I live, but now I have to pay even more...
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This little gem is tucked back in a plaza, easy to miss but I'm here to tell you. You don't want to miss this place!! 
The queso birria tacos are absolutely incredible!!! Please do yourself a favor and stop and grab some!!! I mean look at how they packaged it, with some tlc. I'll be back monthly.
Great job.  Stopped in while traveling. Took good care of me.  Professional. Clean.  No drama or questionable activities going on in the background. :)

My appointment was at 11a. I got there at 1040a. I didn't leave from a simple yearly eye appointment until about 1215p. The actual appointment took less than 15 mins. The office was freezing too. The lady that assisted me and the optometrist were friendly, even though my patience was wearing thin, so that was very good.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We got in off the waitlist....so there is hope even if you plan late. The food was excellent as was the service. Definitely worth the price!  We have dined at several 2-3 Michelin star restaurants and found ourselves comparing catbird to them. Just book it - you won't regret it.
I usually come here once or twice a month, and it's usually pretty good. Not today, cold meatballs and not toasted enough to warm it up.
Really like this place!  They use natural hair color products and the salon has a comfortable vibe.
We enjoyed our frozen yogurt here.  I have sugar restrictions and the serve went to the trouble looking up the grams for me.  The kids gobbled up theirs.
Wow....food was fresh, tasty, awesome.....wtf...this place should be packed....please, stay away on sundays...I love a great brunch....that is all....
OMG I've never experienced a place like this in Chester county and there is plenty to appreciate. Truly special.

I've been here a couple times. It's always great!! I had the House Omelette the last time and it was fantastic. There was a little bit of a wait, but it was hopping on a Saturday afternoon. I try to come here whenever I'm in Tampa. I recommend it to anyone who wants great food at a sensible price, and really friendly staff!!!!
This Dunkin' regularly serves hot coffee that tastes like it has been cut with water. Pass this location for a better one!
The only subway I been to in the area where the food is actually fresh and costumer services is bomb!! Btw they take coupons again so that's another plus!!

text: Easy check in and check out process. Always have the vehicle Ready that I have reserved and their loyalty program is great.

The bar had 8 people and it took 10 minutes to get the bar tenders attention to place a drink order. We asked our waitress twice for water and never received it. Will not recommend or return.

This place is disgusting. Really bad. The rooms are outdated and gross. Opened the hotel door, smelled the room and said, "heck no" (I actually used profanity). Staff is unhelpful and unfriendly. AVOID THIS DISGUSTING DUMP!!!!! We're leaving and going to another hotel. They will not give us a refund and we just got here.

text:
Pinnacle Bank issued a rubberized "Cashier's Check" to me and it bounced sky high. I'm out $6,000. Reported it to this "bank" and have heard nothing. It must be hand-in-glove with the perpetrator.

Beware of any financial instrument you receive from this place.

Yuck. Only came in to use the restroom and it needs help. 

This is a photo of the ceiling hole near the toilet, plus the paper towel dispenser.
Shuttle was waiting for us as we exited the terminal and we were on our way with our car in less than half an hour.
I like the fact that this place delivers and I like the location but the food is just horrible. Nothing I have tried there has been enjoyable.
The staff seemed very inexperienced, and the wait was very long. The donuts were dry and tasted stale.

My dad and I stopped here for a quick cheesesteak -- I did not try the pizza.  The cheesesteak was good, a little more bland than some other places and less dripping with grease, which arguably makes it better but sometimes when you order a cheesesteak you WANT the salt and grease.  :)
I came here and the bank wants to tell me they don't have 35 dollars in coins for me as a small business owner for change
Food and drinks are just ok but wayyyyy overpriced for the quality/quantity you get. The atmosphere is nice though.

So we did Wednesday Bucka shock and I have to say it was outstanding. We also had the fried oysters which were extremely good. And a bottle of rose which was competitively priced. So all in all a great experience. If you're looking for a good buck a shuck  place they absolutely hit the spot!

I have been to this restaurant many times in the past and will continue to go in the future.  The sushi is always very good and they prepare it quickly.  The prices are not too terribly expensive either compared to a lot of other sushi places in town.  The service has always been great too.

So the pizza was good but it wasn't great. And the price for a slice just isn't worth it to me. Maybe it's better if you get a whole pizza. But this was nothing special. Service was good they were all nice and they greeted me right when i walked in. I'll probably go back and give this place another shot just because of that.

If you work a night job and normally sleep in past 8am you're screwed if you live in this place. They schedule landscaping crews from 8-10am and will have multiple people with the loudest possible leaf blowers and lawn mowers ear f****g you bright and early to ensure you never get proper sleep.
Over rated...Overpriced...  I didnt think they had much of a glasses selection..

text: Plan on being there for a long time! Extremely slow employees, friendly people just very slow

This place is pretty bad. Had the duck rice and it came out like reheated old food.

We also ordered the small steamed buns, they seem to just be store bought ones - also did not have the appropriate vinegar dip. 

Probably better food from Panda Express....

In 2014 Dr. Thomas performed an extremely delicate surgery on my 7 year old rabbit to remove a bladder stone. Two other vets declined to try it, but one recommended Dr. Thomas. With excellent care and follow up, he lived another 4 1/2 years. I credit the talent and care of Dr. Thomas and the Aardvark staff for saving his life.

I usually don't write reviews. We just woke up to a mouse in our room. This is in unacceptable...... I writing this review so no one else will waste their money. I paid a little over $350/ night for a room; not worth it. We're staying at the Ritz next time !!

text:

Worst mani ever

Horrible customer service Kelly is the rudest person I've ever met.

I would recommend the place and Rachel to all of my friends!
I love in an out! They are fast efficient and their prices are very reasonable. A young staff is also responsible quick and friendly
