My first review of this place wasn't great. Our order had  things wrong, no chopsticks, and soy sauce was spilled all over the bag and boxes. Today, no chopsticks again and my avocado roll had really brown avocado in it. I want to like this place so bad but there's always something wrong with my order. Ugh!

Horrible experience.  I presume the  person who waited on us was the manager because he was dressed nicely.  He was very rude and seemed pissed off that he had to wait on us.  They were out of sweet and sour sauce and our chicken nuggets were cold.  Won't bother coming here again.

Waited over an hour for our order just to find out they didn't even start on our order yet. I get that you're getting a lot of delivery orders but don't be greedy and take our order, wasted our time. Wasn't the best customer service either. Thanks for our water, the only good part!  :)

I have been here a number of times and have always had good experiences. For some reason, the service was really bad this time. They were not especially busy. Maybe the waiter was having a bad day or he is inexperienced.  The food was also not up to their usual standards.

Been here a few times with my kids. The ice cream is overpriced and the lines are usually long. As the only place at Armature Works that serves dessert, these guys are making a killing. Portion sizes of the exact two ice cream bowls were not the same, which caused controversy between my kiddos. Next time, we'll probably pass...

The Internet was down during my entire stay. Which meant I had to go to Starbucks at 7 in the morning to study for a test for grad school. Also the entire place reeked and it was obvious that they've done no maintenance to the hotel in years. Disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So we use to go to Angelo's and they were great haven't been there in a few months because of the holidays. We ordered tonight and realized prices went up and when we got the food it was different and not as great. I mean it was ok but it use to be better. I'm wondering if they have new owners.

Mediocre food for unreasonable prices. The pasta sauce is homemade I believe but there was way too much olive oil which drowned out the herbs and other flavors and pooled at the bottom of the meatballs. Margherita pizza had similar sauce so there was absolutely no flavor to it. Very disappointed after reading such great reviews.

Sushi was okay, very small sushi rolls with very little fish in each roll. Nothing really stood out here. Even the avocado on top of the rolls was cut super thin. Also found an eyelash in my roll. Ugh .... At least the server was very nice. I think there are many other competing sushi restaurants that are much worth it than here.

Seafood udon 4 stars
Chicken teriyaki 2 stars chicken was over cooked and dry
Dragon rolls 3 stars
California rolls 4 stars
Prawns tempura 5 stars
Decor 4 stars
Service 2 stars

Not that impressed with our experience.
I won't drive across the city to visit again.
Yelp let me down.

Food good. Very small menu choices. Salad is small. You just get lettuce,  tomatoes, n carrots. Soda selection is small. They give you only 2 warm rolls n ice cold butter.
The music they play is Mexican. The staff is Mexican. The name is Italian.  You would think all Italian workers n music.

One of the worst locations on the north side of Indy. Today there were TWO people working on drinks for over 13 people waiting....it took the cashier over 7 tries to put an iced coffee drink order in correctly. I get these are difficult times, but managers need to schedule enough employees to take care of customers.

Mediocre pasta for high prices. Their pasta was $24 (parpadelli) for barely any meat, lots of onions and lots of pasta. There is also lack of consistency, sometimes raviolis are dry, sometimes good. I think I've given this place enough chances for their food to taste better.

Saturday evening at 9:30pm we went in and a guy greeted us and said the kitchen is closed.  Hours on the door said 10pm, and they have a bright neon "open" light.  So if you want to try out this place go before the staff decides they are done for the evening.

Every time I go to this McDonald's I'm highly disappointed. The wait time is always ridiculous. Especially in the morning. Most of the staff is rude or incompetent. 95% I receive an incorrect order. This store really needs to clean house and start all over!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The employees are the best thing about this car wash. Since Champion took over the quality sucks!! It leaves soap on my cars after the rinse and the driers leave water on the car, I called several times to complain but they are to embarrass to return my call. Go somewhere Else Champion Car Wash Sucks!

Don't go to this Wendy's if you actually want fast food. Tried several time because it's close to work but no matter what time i go, even if there's no one else in line, it takes forever. Used up my whole 30min break trying to get a burger only to have to go back to work with no burger

Eh. Sushi wasn't great. I got the 3 roll special and the rolls I got were pretty bland. I also got the seaweed salad which I figured would be difficult to mess up but I was wrong. I took one bite and couldn't eat any more. I feel bad giving 1 star so I put 2 :/

UPDATE. This Wendy's has CHANGED their chili. It tastes different, and is mad spicy. It has black pepper visible all in it, and is just not good. Go to the Ridge Pike or Montgomeryville locations instead. I seriously can't even stomach this Wendy's chili anymore.

This restaurant underpays and overworks children... yikes. 
Have fun with those civil penalties! 

Glad to know those kids are getting compensated though. 

Hit funny, cool, or helpful if you're against this type of business operation and want to support those kids and people abused for their work and time.

Food is fine just the employees seem to have a attitude and lack experience slow business but waited like 10 minutes when there were like no more than 1  ahead of me and the person serving me typically threw my food at me but to make matters worse there seems to be drug addicts, but everything else is okay
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The taste is OK but not memorable. There was nothing wow about it. In fact, we took the Supreme pizza home, fresh right out of their over. 10 minutes later, I tried the pizza and it was soggy and cold. It's definitely not NY style to me. Save your money and go elsewhere, even Pizza Hut or Dominoes.

I would never shop here, the reputation they had was never good. You could smell sour meat as you walk in the market. People who do shop there obviously don't value their stomachs. Maybe they like having food poisoning. It's a Cousins on Baltimore Ave, I'll never shop there for food. I'll buy napkins, and paper towels!!!

Definitely not the original. Beignets were doughy and not crispy on the outside, WAY too much sugar, I get it's supposed to have a lot but this was drowned double the amount at the original location. 

Cafe au lait here was burnt and not really even drinkable. One sip and I was done. I'll stick to the original.

Trying to be understandable with covid and staff shortages. But we honestly think they forgot about us. 

It took forever to get out drinks out and a table that sat down much later got their food before us 

Our waiter was friendly when she came to the table ...  food was great but not worth the wait

Have waited in the drive-through line for at least 10 minutes and still waiting while I write this review. Came for a quick iced coffee, but sadly am going to have to stick with the Starbucks we have all around this town. This is the second time I haven't had a great experience with the time of their service. /:

TERRIBLE! Don't waste your money. It's a shit hole. Dirty rooms, disgusting pool and you can't breathe due to poor ventilation. We will NEVER book Wyndham again. If you stay on the first floor, your room will smell of the curry they're cooking up in the restaurant inside the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was the worst place I've ever eaten in Nashville. My meal and 1 glass of wine was $60. The lasagna was fine until I pulled a large hair out of it. The gnocchi was bland and the "grilled" chicken was a rubbery, boiled, unseasoned chicken breast. One word to describe Giovanni west- YUCK.

This place is a disgrace.  Rude service and fraudulent business practices, in my humble opinion.  Repeat offenders of no deliveries with no notice, refusal of refunds, etc.  I filed a complaint with grubhub and am submitting this review here in hopes others avoid getting ripped off/treated poorly by this company.

I went there today attempting to pick up foods. During the COVID 19 pandemic, no one, not a single person who handles foods there was wearing a mask... I left. And I will not go back. The workers didn't seem to care, nor the managers or owners. Do I trust foods from there? Sorry, no.

It's ehhhhh....we won't go back. Which is a bummer because we really love hibachis. When you pull up it looks closed. The pond inside that they feature is dirty. And the windows need washing. The place setting was not good. BUT the waitress was nice and the guy at the grill was nice and talented, food is better than environment.

The sushi was good. The service was poor. We ordered take out and we're told it would be ready in 15-20 minutes. We ended up sitting around for 45 minutes before our rolls were ready. We would have appreciated more honest communication about the time it would take to make our order.

More grease and MSG than one should have to ever experience, even in a cheap Americanized version of a Chinese restaurant.  Second star is for the staff, who are at least polite and do a decent job of keeping this small restaurant (there are maybe 8 or 10 tables) clean.

Took a suit jacket and pants in to be cleaned for my husband. They only returned the jacket. Weeks later they finally found out they gave them to someone else who had returned them and they sat there for weeks not knowing who's they were until we kept calling repeatedly. Unreal!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This location is awful. It's as if they take random people off the street to work there. I've never seen the same people there. It's suppose to be hit and ready but even if you call ahead it still takes thirty minutes. I'd suggest paying a little more for better pizza

Don't get the shrimp! They don't devein them. Don't get the veggie spring rolls either because they have pork in them. After I advised the staff I was told "we checked the box, it's tofu."  Last I checked, tofu doesn't taste, smell or have the same texture as pork.

The customer service when the wrong pizza was delivered to my house was RIDICULOUS. I was on hold for 20 minutes to even speak with the manager who was less than helpful. At least I got my money refunded.

The only reason I'm even giving this two stars is because the food from here is typically good.

This place is clean, but the menu misrepresents the food. My wife had a SoBro burger with no beef. I had Nashville Hot Chicken biscuits and all it was was Tyson chicken tenders with cayenne peppers sprinkled on. My sweet potato fries were cold. Two tiny biscuits for $11.

I think I'm done with this place. Location is so convenient. Not enough care given to preparing food. Not cooked well, cheese is never melted. Always sorry I went there after I go. Most Wendy's are becoming this way around here. Ruining their reputation. I did go to a Wendy's in KY that was amazing!!!!

Its freezing in here at all times. Ever tried doing cardio with lungs full of ice? And what kind of gym doesn't even have a scale anywhere? I'm not even going to get into the obnoxious "lunk alarm" constantly going off. Its clean and the staff is friendly, but this place sucks.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We went there on my my boyfriends birthday.  There was so much hype.  It didnt meet the hype.  For  huge pizza lovers we were highly disappointed.  Bland pizza.  Service was not so great.  Thankfully we had a coupon.  WWe will not be back ever and will not reccommend! Poor parking!

I ordered the barbecue burger and it was absolutely horrible. When they made the onion rings that go on the burger they left the skin of the onion on and so underneath the breading was the hard part of the onion skin. The burger was anemic and not hot nor juicy. Way too much barbecue sauce. Disappointing experience

Tried to plan my rehearsal dinner there. My bridemaid called, I called, my fiancé called. We each called this location and Ambler and were constantly told someone would call us back. I even got "can I call you right back?"... Not a word. Wrote a review on Facebook and got blocked! Guess they don't want business.

Store is never open during early business hours like advertised. Ive tried to come here around 6am each day and it's still closed.  Their yelp info says open 24/7 which is completely untrue. Whoever runs this particular location needs some help or this store will lose alot of business. Sure lost mine.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: As it's a McDonald's fast food restaurant I know not to expect much here. BUT this specific location is probably one of the worst. I Ordered 2 oatmeals and received not only old dry oatmeal but no spoon to eat it. Also no napkins. The disgusting  slobs that work here really make this location a huge failure.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This chase is BEYOND SLOW. THIS IS INSANE. I got in line at 1:00pm with three cars in front in the business line and I am now leaving at 2:00pm. The other lines have being going somewhat fast. So now I've wasted my whole entire lunch break and am late to go back to work:) Thank you Chase. I appreciate it. GET IT TOGETHER.

Oil Change- Done Expeditiously 
Maintenance of the guest area is/was extremely horrible. Empty cups laying around it looked as though the floor hadn't been mopped in months the coffee pot was stained with OLD coffee. The restroom was so disgusting to the point the smell of it was making me sick...
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Worst customer service. Do not go here. I needed a car because me be is at the dealership for repair and parts will take two or three days. These guys said they had no cars. I understand. He would not even look at other locations to help me out just nope sorry. I was the first not customer anywhere in sight. Pathetic.

Great selection and right next to where I live so that is great! However some of their employees are rude and angry and really annoying to deal with. If you are going to hire micro managing assholes then get me a self checkout so I don't have to deal with them

With all the money you're saving by eliminating the only reason we used to come- (the all you can eat sushi)- buy your staff new shirts that don't advertise it! The world is full of businesses that are using Covid as an excuse to not give a crap anymore. If you bring back the special we'll be back- even if the price is higher.

The pizza is good, but the service sucks! First of all I was charged for the three topping, but only got one. Then they wanted to charge me for a tiny cup of ranch. I ordered wine and they gave me beer? I went up to order another glass of wine. They ignored me and answered phone instead. I will not go back there.

Beer selection here is off the walls, crazy ones that I haven't even heard before. The interior is modern and has a draft room in the back. 

BUT...12 bucks for a 4 pack of Allagash...pricey...

Overall, a very high mark up on everything...pass if u wanna save some money

Food is pretty mediocre here. Went for a friends bday party and ordered a shrimp/chicken type of thing and you can taste the shrimp must've been old or frozen...not fresh at all. 

Sweet spot for a date cause the decor is nice and they got an outside spot. 

Best part: byob.

Terrible service.  Had to wait 20 minutes on a bus to arrive to the terminal.  The bus was standing room only w very little AC.  When we arrived at the car lot the selection was terrible.  I asked the attendant about other cats and he was rude and not helpful at all.

This Burger King has got to be the worst. The WORST customer service. The WORST in the world in order correctness. The WORST!! Stay away. McDonalds ,Wendy's and Taco Bell are all up the street. Just spend the extra 5 mins to go there instead. Thank me later.

Lebanon, Mt Juliet City Guides joins Mt Juliet Love and Music City Mingle in celebrating this business friendly global luxury Hotel. It is so refreshing as a business person on the move constantly to be in an environment so engaging and enriching.  You have earned our Big Daddy 5 Stars Review! Compliments of Chaplain Oscar Smith
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was at this location at approximately 12pm on 6/27/20 and the kid working the drive through had his mask on like a chin strap. The lack of regard for customer health will have me NEVER visiting this location again. I threw my food out because who knows what was happening where I could not see.

This place is in sketchy area, trash in the parking lot, food with ants on the floor inside, the floors had a lot of dirt & mud everywhere. Not sure if it's the employee/owners day off from their duties but this place is definitely not clean. The place is cheap tho! That's good & the machines seem to work well
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Worlds most convenient bank my a**. Every time I go out of town (which is every week for business), they block my account.  It's a pain in the tush and they say they can't do anything about it. On hold for 22 minutes trying to unblock it last time. I'm fed up and switching banks!

Over-hyped and over-priced in my opinion. Don't get me wrong. They have good mac and cheese in several creative variations (most of which I would never care to try) but you REALLY have to be a Mac-n-Cheese lover to appreciate paying $9 for a main meal consisting of a small skillet of mac-n-cheese.

Staff needs to work on the way the speak to the customers and how they treat them. Pretty rude. Then to top it off the drinks they make aren't up to normal Starbucks standards. I've given this Starbucks multiple chances.  I'm done. They need some serious training.

Honestly, this was maybe the worst fried chicken I've had from a place that was supposed to get it right.  I compared to something off the buffet line at Golden Corral.  The service was good and the staff was friendly.  Dunno, maybe an off night but I wouldn't go back.

Love coming here! The staff is great & open to suggestion. They will really take care of you if you tell them what you want. The VIP card they now offer is pretty cool to. Earn towards free services. 

I definitely recommend DT Nails. Their pricing for their services makes for a great overall value.

Service not great. Had to keep asking for my pastries long after getting my coffee. Mocha super sweet (?). Coffee prep station very messy. Very long lines to drive up extending onto busy Bay St. Large dining area but over air conditioned so we ate outside.

Aside from a nice neighborhood, what's then point of having a hot tub when it's cold as heck after 40 minutes of warming up...also a little frustrated with the one working treadmill, a squeaky secondary treadmill, and a dysfunctional elliptical.  Aside from that, all is well.

Ive been wanting to try this place out for years.  me and my fiance finally had an opportunity to try it. I was let down. I ordered the salmon which was dry, my fiancee ordered the pork chops, it was burnt and full of fat. The meals are definitley over priced for the quality.  I will give 1 star due to location and environment.

Been coming to this location for about 3 years now. Never have I ever been charged extra on a free drink for my birthday. It's always been free no matter what I've gotten. This time they charged me extra for almond milk. Rather go to Starbucks where my "free" reward drink is actually free.

This place is the LAST place to go for a haircut.  Plus, the people that own this place are 100% racist and will treat you like trash if you aren't white.  I'd rather go to Great Clips than EVER go back to this place again.

Overpriced, rude and racist......no thank you.

Went in today to dine with a friend and got terrible customer service from the manager and the food was disgusting everything was cold and under cooked. Very displeased and am never returning. Manager argued with me and repeatedly said well my customers are happy as if I wasn't a customer because I wasn't happy. Very displeased

I would like to give 5 stars but having two little ones in the pool, the staff came in right at 11pm and stood, not politely quite intimidating to say the least demanding ppl to get out. To tell a 10 year old the pool opens next day at 8am when finding out its 9am was not a fun situation. Will stay elsewhere
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My Mother went here to get a shampoo and hair cut her hair being short above shoulder and when it came time to pay the price givin was $45 .mind you no color. Just be aware that hair cuts start @$25 .so that means that they charged her $20 for a shampoo..really!! There is a reason. That their parking lot is always empty.....

The Szechuan beef tastes like they cooked it in chemicals. The pepper steak had no taste at all. The teriyaki chicken had no flavor, like they put the unseasonal chicken on a grill and called it good. And the hot and sour soup was only hot and not sour. Overall 10/10 would not ever go to again. I've eaten army food that is better.

Not crazy about this place - Ordered lunch a few times here since my job is walking distance from the place. I would order online, and I come in and it's never ready, there online system is terrible. Than, I ask for well done - and it's medium. I don't like the service. Will not be going back.

I agree the prices are high. Actually I thought I was at Citizens Bank Park until I realized that the Phillies weren't playing. As for the custard, there is none. The cone I was served appeared to be frozen "Moo-Moo Milk" like the fast food joints serve as shakes. No wonder this is Custard's LAST STAND!

I think this place may have been really good in the past. There was certainly a crowd of locals. The food left much to be desired unfortunately. Pasta overcooked, alfredo too creamy. Decent chicken parm. Homey and welcome atmosphere but i won't be going back for the food.

The coffee was made with little to no care at all. I
The attitude from the employees there is basic. You'll be lucky to get any eye contact whatsoever. The coffee was so hot that the cup it came in was becoming flimsy. It's just not a pleasant experience 
 And at the prices they charge...

Their food is pretty good but I just placed a $60 order online and  they still charge a 3% "convenience fee" for using a debit card. I can understand if it's under a certain dollar amount but for an order that big, they should be able to absorb the transaction fee.

Food mediocre,  service non-existent. 

They were quick to seat us but then very, very slow with everything else.  The salsa is not bad, but the queso is watered down and the chips are too thick and not very fresh.  The portions are not small but not well balanced in the seasoning department,  mostly heat and salt.

Just meh.  18.00 breakfast was majorly lacking.  Few options and what options they had were just meh.  I've had better breakfast at hotels with free continental breakfast.  Won't eat here again. Definitely with the trip across the bridge into CW for better breakfast.

The Vets especially Dr. Johnson is amazing! The office staff not so much. The prices are wonderful and they do a lot for the animal rescue groups that  is what has me driving 45mins to go there BUT don't expect great customer service. One front office person will tell you one thing and one will tell you another. Very frustrating!

Everything was great! Fishbowls a fair price, dance floor was great, and bouncers were friendly. ALL EXCEPT the manager who yelled me out of the bar due to me trying to stop my friend from getting scammed by one of their bartenders. Don't expect to feel welcome there.

Really disappointed for the extra charge to "toast " my veggie burrito especially since I said no cheese or sour cream which are probably the two most expensive ingredients that I am saving them from putting on the burrito.....time to head to another place....bummer

Been to this spot twice in the last month. Both times the services was horribly slow. I actually had just came from the king of Prussia store which was twice as busy with the same amount of employees and got in and out in less than a fraction of the time it took this store to make one simple latte.

Hot plates topped with cold food? How's that work? Must be the heat lamps. If You want idle food hit up Panda Express. This place is the most overrated Mexican food in Tucson. The menu is average and the staff are unfriendly with customers. As a native from West Tucson I definitely don't recommend this place!

If I could give this place NEGATIVE stars I would. This place is the worst nail salon I've ever been. I asked for a gel manicure and within 3 minutes he was done my "manicure". 2 bloody nails later...I asked for him to stop and pay. Also, the service is HORRIBLE!!!!!! Do not go go this place. Pictures to follow.

Stopped here for a quick lunch today, the food quality is what you would expect from a high school concession stand. I'm not necessarily upset, but I feel like a "restaurant" that focuses on hotdogs could give you a little higher quality food. Overall it's convenient and I'd stop again when pressed for time.

Only came here to support a singer that performs here. Was my first time eating here, I got the linguine & clams. The clams were a weird green color and the sauce was very oily, it kind of grossed me out. I only took a few bites. the chocolate cake and cappuccino is very good, however

I have gone to this nail salon for years the man was usually nice the woman always had an attitude.   Recently the man has gotten a attitude also, you can only take but so much.... I'm done.  Also the woman doesn't know how to give a pedicure if her life depended on it.

Won't take responsibility for a scratch to my rim after it jolted my wheel mid wash. Another customer had a similar experience recently causing a flat tire. Filed a BBB complaint two weeks ago and they haven't responded. I haven't been back since to use my unlimited plan because it's awful customer service.

Awful!!! It is obvious drive-thru is the priority! Walked in one person ordering was it at the counter! I'm getting ONE drink ---- 13 minutes in I ask how many drinks in front of me?? 4!!!!??? Money back thanks and goodbye! Tons of employees --- crowded actually.  Ridiculous

My husband years ago would come here and he said it was delicious. He recently took me here and it was bad. The service isn't great, the salsa is watered down, chips were stale, sodas are flat, alcohol doesn't taste right in whatever you order, and the food isn't great either. Taste and feels like a glorified Taco Bell.

Got the elite wash. $39. Very disappointing. Took car home abs vacuumed the many spots  they missed. Poorly cleaned cup holders and dash too.  They do a rush job that is not thorough. This is my second bad experience here. Wil not return. Just not worth the money.

This Starbucks on big bend is honestly the worst one I have ever been to. The service is unbearably slow and I have never been to a Starbucks that basically made a hot sweet milk drink instead of a creme brûlée latte with two extra shots of espresso. Disgusting.

We had great service here this morning. The staff was energetic and friendly. They were happy to help us and even brightened our Friday morning. The food was fresh and our order was quick and correct. Way to go McDonald's!! Way to make our breakfast a positive and peppy experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Live in the building and my dog had a seizure and possible stroke. Quickly ran down and was told the earliest they could seem me was later in the afternoon by the desk clerk. Horrible. . She said I was better off taking him to an emergency hospital. December 3, 930am.

When you make the wrong drink admit it. A skinny cinnamon dulce is nothing like a macchiato. There is no drizzle and it's made with skim milk not whole. Thanks for wasting the time it took to stop and the money I prepaid with my app. Glad I can go back to my own neighborhood soon. Oh... and there was NO ONE in the store.

If you really love this place then you haven't ever eaten at a real sushi restaurant.  The California roll I got (I was scared to order raw for delivery) is basically grocery store quality.  The chicken dumplings are ok but allllll I taste is ginger.  Expect what you might get at the mall if you go here.

Since they raised the wages and the price of a carwash, the quality of the service and attention to detail has gone down the tubes....We have been taking our cars there 2 times a month for years but no more....Instead of honoring my request to clean the wheels I was told they look fine......WTF

I have dealt with numerous vets over the years.  I have only ever had to use one that had a worse manner than this vet and their office.  I cancelled the appointment I had made, and will take my dog to the Ophthalmologists at Mizzou before I will make an appointment here again.

I would highly suggest not even wasting your time applying to these apartments. All of the employees told me different information about when the deposit would be made. I was ripped off before I could even move in! This is not good business and there are other apartments in the area that are much more worth the money than this one.

Can you spare the Salsa???  Omg this was the 1st latino restaurant that I ran out of Salsa 2 times before I ran out of chips. Portions are small. We went during Happy Hour so the prices were reduced. Unfortunately so are the portions. Frozen Margarita in a 10 oz water glass, Seriously?

I used to come here often, but it is out of the way for me now. I was nearby so I gave it a shot. The service is worse than it used to be, though not the worst I have ever had. Ultimately, all of the three stars that have come off are due to the price. Seriously, $28 for a wash? Complete rip-off. I won't be back again.

Nice staff but very average quality Mexican food. Their fish selection consisted of Tilapia. That should give you a good indication of the level of quality. However, I took my chances, ordered the (Tilapia) fish tacos, took one bite and sent it back. This place really more or less resembles a fast food Mexican joint.

Worst White Castle in America. I travel a lot. When I put my order in she cut me off halfway so I pulled up to the window to finish my order and she was all mad throwing stuff, Slamming the window and texting all her friends while taking other people's orders. she got mine  wrong... And the Line was super long so I just trashed it.

If I could give it less than one star I would. Bad food, poor service and dear god was it overpriced. This place, with it's phony bologna vibe (really, a dj is necessary?), is clearly run by people who have never run a restaurant. Do yourself a favor and stick to maurepas across the street. B

Not responsive to customers, unapologetic when out of requested items. Generally cavalier attitude toward customer service- spoke on the phone and in person and just got the impression the person behind the counter didn't care. Donuts are pricey- there should be some consideration for the customer.

Ok so maybe it's not always the same excellent food. First time everything was excellent. We went there last tues and was very disappointed. Two of the three orders were wrong and the food was bland at best. Cheese dip was good though.  Guess its hit or miss here.

Thanks for fixing the outlets at the farm table!   

Congratulations Bryan on your promotion!  

Your engagement with customers and attention to customer service will surely shine through making this one of the best *$'s in the city.

I look forward to the introduction of Nitro to your location!

This place is efficient and delivers high quality. They actually read the label, feel the materials and let you know the best cleaning method for the garment. I've been in the Southampton area for 20 years and have struggled to find a reputable and trustworthy place. Trust these people!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The Westshore Grand, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel on Kennedy Boulevard in Tampa is a great hotel that has much to offer and is in the middle of everything. I really like the rooftop pool and the views from the rooms. The staff here is very friendly and accommodating to make sure that you have everything that you need for the best stay
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I got kicked of here the other day, I fell asleep in the soup. My narcolepsy kicked in and my grandson wouldn't get me my medication. My hoveround also moved way too slow. The only reason this place gets three stars is because of the glory hole in the men's bathroom.

I believe the staff is stealing money. I was told cash only.  When asked why the cashier said because it was after 8pm. I've been eating McDonald's all my life and never heard of any rules like that. I was left with no choice but to leave bc I only had debit.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: First time trying this place and they did excellent! Super impressed. I got the ultimate wash where the armor all the interiors and my car looks brand new. They didn't skip out on the cup holders or dash either! Vacuuming was great too especially since I have a furry dog. Only about 20-30 minute wait.

Been going here since i was like 14, so that's almost 20 years. i've tried other salons and i always come back to them. Vy, the daughter, is so kind and really knows her stuff. Tina is so gentle and creative, any design i want she executes, and she's a brow magician.

The food here is awesome!!!!!! They have a new roll called big easy roll, which was deep fried but it was so good! We also got their po boy and Lsu roll. Our 2nd time here and we loved it. Family friendly restaurant, which was perfect for our little family! The food came out super fast. Glad to have this in the parish!

Amazing experience! All the employees are super professional, talented and delightful! I had my hair cut by Michele, and it was the best cut I've ever gotten! And I have been going to high end salons for years! I will never spend $30+ at a high end salon ever again knowing I can get an even BETTER cut here! Highly recommended!!

Avoid this McDonald's at all costs. This is by far the slowest, most incompetent place you could possibly order food from. I love a few minutes away, and will drive the a further McDonald's for food (when we do get it).  It if you are looking for some Mcshitty service and food, then this is your spot.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There's an x-ray at all Dunkin' Donuts just make their own rules. Change the lid so you spilled coffee all over your car locked the doors unlocked the doors no bathrooms and now this one doesn't let you order anything on the inside at all because they're too busy with the Uber eats unbelievable horrible horrible service

Awesome service, great low prices and good quality!! Thank you,will be back!! And they have a huge lot of inventoried tires! I went in there for 1 tire blow out, and left with 3 like new tires. Very very fast considering its on a Friday right before a holiday weekend. Great job guys!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Leo's has it all, great food, superb service, music, dancing and a great bar.  Very conveniently located on US 19 with lots of attached parking.  I highly recommend Leo's wings and all their appetizers.  They are pretty good at accommodating dietary needs.

"Do you like it raw?" the menu asks me as I first gaze upon it. I ordered the McNabb roll after my favorite former Eagles footballer, and it was as delicious as Donovan was in his prime. This restaurant is great for groups, love the BYOB, and I definitely love it raw

You get to choose what meats you would like to have, tortillas are delicious, rice is delicious, beans are delicious everything is delicious!!! I recommend the avocado Chile sauce. This place is the cleanest local Mexican restaurant in this city! Plus the 7 dollar baby sized burrito fills you up all day.

This is probably the slowest McDonalds I have ever been to, and they are constantly out of anything I would ever want to purchase from this fast food chain. I have no idea how this place stays in business while always finding a different way to disappoint it's customers on a day to day basis.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I went in to get my acrylic filled. I had some fungus under one of my nails and so we decided to remove them which was fine. The down part is they removed them by picking and using a face nail to slide in between my nails. One part that she could not get off the nail tech just filed down and painted over.

My experience was very poor and not what I expected from a highly rated brand such as Hyatt . My room was clean for the most part but there was a few missed areas, the breakfast was terrible, and a woman that I assumed was a maid barged into my room unexpectedly. I should have followed my gut and booked with Hilton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The wings ( extra hot ) and lobster bisque are really good. but the restaurant only survives because there is no competition around.   The service is horrible and the food mediocre and way over priced.  Bar prices are also over priced.  When more restaurants come into the area  Rhodes will struggle to compete.

I love in-N-out burger, but today I was dissatisfied, my burger was under cooked and red in several areas. There was a lot of people there but that doesn't mean you have to under cook burgers to get it out faster, other than that the fries were great and the service was not too bad

Overpriced and I frequently end up with digestive issues after eating here. My husband has an iron gut and has had issues, too. There are a lot of great Italian food options available in the area and this is not one of them. Menu is basic at best and it's poorly executed.

My "service engine soon" light came on after an oil change here.  Went to a different place and they found that either the dip stick was not fully seated or fill cap wasn't on correctly.  They quickly fixed the issue and the light turned off after about 10 minutes of driving.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I love Starbucks. I am a barista at Starbucks but this location is ALWAYS slow and they ALWAYS mess up my tall vanilla latte in a Grande cup with whip cream. It's really not a complicated order and I'm saying that from working at the busiest Starbucks in the world.

My car looks a lot better... until you look closely.  Crumbs and the wrapper to my kids' breakfast bar were left behind.  My trunk was not done, and they didn't clean underneath my wipers.  Polite staff, quick in and out process, and not terribly expensive.  Definitely not a thorough job.

One guy I believe name Adrian said I couldn't change my address over the phone and that I had to change it online or in the branch. Found out I could change my address thanks to the chase on Grant. They are not the most helpful people when it comes to taking care of your account wasn't pleased at all with them.

A fantastic place to buy liquor if you have a penchant for smug assholes ringing you up. I usually go in there after some biking on the Monon and they look at me as if I've just escaped from an outhouse. Hey there, Fauntleroy, you're working a liquor store, tone down the high brow b.s.

Spider roll made. Deep fried with the taste of old oil, sushi rice hard. When requested iced green tea was told all they had was hot,suggested they bring a glass of ice on the side. Miso soup cold and served 1/4 of bowl side of rice served in chipped dinnerware.

Not worth the cost. Incredibly over priced. The food is mediocre, but it's not worth $25-30 a portion. Host had no clue what social distancing was. Packed us all into the bar and next to the only other couples that were sitting there. Server was great. Everything was lack luster. Won't be back.

They are not nice. Don't tip them they never say thank you they have their own conversations. They barely look at you. Grab what you need and go. Sometimes i don't even think they listen to what u want and just plop it on the table. I REPEAT DONT TIP THEM.

This ice cream shop has a very good quality product yet the workers are not organized you don't know where the line begins to order the place is messy, it's not clean there's no trash cans to put the trash outside the store the glass doors are dirty -If  this issues were addressed I'd give it a 4+

Worst burger king ever, this is the perfect example of a bad restaurant. Menu screens always off, soda machine never full, employees talking with each other while I'm ordering the food. And she complains because I said it lauder. Definitely need a manager from a better area.

This place is hipster, not tasty.

They do offer alcoholic ice cream flavors, but their "fun" selection of flavors doesn't make up for the lack of taste. The ice cream flavors were really off putting, makes me wonder how this place has great reviews... thanks obama

Food was amazing staff is either overworked or insanely slow, Heard 1 lady complaining that because the governor ordered it doesn't mean it's a law, It was clearly a staff members the other staff members were yelling at her, She was threatening to quit Over it hope she does Place has very good food Staff needs to help

Really bad service. I ordered prickly pear shrimp taco, but only got a shrimp taco-- the waitress was just not listening. Ordered another margarita, but took 30 mins for them to bring it to me. Don't think it's a place I would like to go to for another time or recommend to others...

Completely ridiculous, One kind of bread.  The poor kid behind the counter had no idea how to make the sandwich my mom ordered.  She had to pick something else. He was the only one working, No help!  
Hardly any toppings, People walking out!  Is there a manager around anywhere??  What a joke!

Not impressed and probably won't be back.  Blandsville this should be renamed.  The funghi pasta is mushrooms over pasta with a water splashed over it.  It was the epitome of UNFLAVOR.  The chicken in the alfredo tasted like nothing as well.  The higight was the tiramisu, but I can find that just about anywhere.

Very popular local spot in Hyde park. This place is always busy and good for a quick bite. But typically is very busy, loud, and crowded. Service is always very average and food is overpriced for the portions. Things add up quickly for what you get at this casual spot that is hyped up far more than its worth.

For weeks I haven't been able to use the TD bank app because the website has not worked !! This is a horrible inconvenience because I do the majority of my banking online , and they (TD) don't seem interested in fixing the problem !! TD bank doesn't deserve not one star !!!

No, just No.

I'm sure this will be deleted with all the other negative posts that I know others have posted.  

But all I can say is if your pet needs help, there are more qualified and compassionate places.   

The experience was far beyond bad.   So sad.

Lucky's is always there when everything else is closed but that's about all its good for. If your looking for Chinese food Chili Szechuan is just 1 block and AMAZING. If your looking for dutches, backwoods, and loosies just go to 49th and Baltimore where their cheaper and fresher.

The donuts were o.k. The cleanness of the place was kinda gross and we got there at 9am. It was also annoying trying to tell the guy what donut we wanted when he himself didn't know what location they were at cause no labels. . I will stick to Doughboy donuts

Falling behind their competitors in both quality and value. It isn't even a good "quick option" anymore because of the bad food. McDonalds is now phasing our the dollar menu. Odd that people still going there in my opinion with all of the better choices available.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The Bloody Mary and pickled green beans are fantastic. Service is NOT enthusiastic. If you come here do NOT associate this with the hospitality or service you will receive in New Orleans. The hospitality in New Orleans is definitely top notch. Just not here. But your options are limited in this airport.

Second time ive been there in the morning , been told i cant order a burger , told broiler was down , i can understand once but twice ? Its BURGER king & i cant order a burger ? I aint the too crazy on things but this makes me go crazy , lol -fatpeopleproblems?

Look delicious... minus the fly. The other day I saw a fly pee on my curtain and watched it absorb into about an inch of a wet spot. That fly has been on that donut for going on 4mins and counting. Donuts look so good but I'm afraid I'm not brave enough like my friend who ordered two and enjoyed them.

This bar was appropriate to visit so close to Halloween, because our experience here was horrifying. I don't want to waste anymore of my time on this place than I already spent there. I feel sorry for the bands that have to play to meager crowds of disgruntled patrons. Even Jon Taffer from Bar Rescue couldn't save this disaster.

I wish there was a 0 star rating , guy in the drive thru was so rude , I couldn't hear him thru the speaker , then I said hi! He replied I TOLD  YOU TO WAIT!  I just left I should share this location in my social media so people never go there I'm sure 500k followers will want to know about it!

Cold hash browns. This McDonald's ALWAYS has cold hash browns. And the service is by far the worst of all the McDonald's restaurants I've visited in my lifet. I've given this particular McDonald's several chances to redeem themselves and they've managed to fail every time. This place is a joke
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Multiple credit cards and mortgage and car loans and I'm done with chase for good.  They don't care about you at all and I recently sold my house and both realtors were discussing how bad chase is and how they have a lot of hidden fees that other banks and credit unions don't charge for .

This was the most disappointing pizza I've ordered. Crust and sauce were tasty, toppings very sparse. I ordered pepperoni and extra cheese, there were maybe 3 slices of pepperoni on half the pie. The chicken was was the same, maybe 3 pieces on half the pie. Don't waste your time or money.

Meh. Tasted like day old sushi. Hard rice. Slightly browning cucumber. Low-quality ingredients. It didn't even look good. 

If I were you, I'd save your money and pass. 

I'm still struggling to find a good sushi place in this area. I'd rank Sushi Land in Bryn Mawr way above this one (and I'm not even that crazy about Sushi Land).

Always double check your menu on the screen before you pay.
There's communication issue. Strongly recommend use numbers after menu such as "salmon and tuna poke bowl, 2 of them" other than "2 salmon and tuna bowl." You might get twin Salmon roll and 2 Tuna poke bowls...

I ordered sashimi - salmon, tuna, and yellowtail.  All three types, bad fish.  Not spoiled, but definitely turning and slippery bordering on slimy.  I did not finish the fish, but I did pay the full tab and left without riling them.  Watch out for the fish!

I can't stand bad pizza but my kids do. So that's as far as I'm going with this review. The only thing it has going for it is location to the schools. Everything comes from a frozen bag. Can't say enough how aweful it is but 12 year olds love it. So there you go.

Seems like a nice place. Cheesesteak was the smallest thing I have ever had! It would have been ok if it had been exceptional? It was not. Had better cheesesteaks in places that had no right selling them. Onion rings seemed like food service stuff? Not worth it. Spent $13 to be disappointed.

Place is great and convenient, not bad if you don't mind, very very low water pressure, no hot water, only warm, thermostats that are not connected, really firm bed, stale bagels, and not able to find a way to get to hotel if driving east on Gult to Bay,THEN THIS IS THE PLACE TO GO.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been to this location a few times..all I can say is when it is crowded u risk the chance of being cheated.. I ordered a Frapp.. large.. my mistake, I drove off should have gone back..was pressed for time.. ended up with nothing but chocolate syrup and ice!! .almost 6 dollars wasted!!! because they want to rush your drink!!

DON'T RENT AT THE RETREAT! This is the most deceptive, undermining place I have ever dealt with. Management is sub par at best,false advertisement is rampant. Continually changing rules via random, inappropriate e-mails. This place is a total waste of your $$. Heed our advice and look elsewhere.

The donuts are delicious, but stay away from the coffee. I ordered a latte and as I was drinking it, I felt something slimy and chunky in my mouth. I took the lid off, and there was a thin layer of something really gross around the rim of the cup. Curdled milk, or something? Not sure, but I will stick to coffee elsewhere now..

Who ever works the window needs to get another job. Not only was our food absolutely disgusting and inedible she was rude. The tomatoes are rotten on the salad. You can tell by the taste of the food and the color of the fries that they haven't changed out their grease for frying in a LONG time.

After reading all the good reviews, I went on to place an order for 1 large pizza, 10 buffalo wings, and a large fry. 

Buffalo wings was trash (undercooked), but the pizza made up for it. 

Delivery driver was disrespectful. I ordered through Yelp and tipped in advance, so I couldn't take it back.

I know they are closed right now, (seasonal) but the worst service since the new owners took over.  Workers licking their fingers while preparing orders and when complained to the owner, he said it is hard to find good help.  They have forever lost my business.

Meh!  No better than grocery store sushi the night we were there. The wife and I ordered the Valentine's Day special, and it was slapped together  without care. The rolls fell apart and had way too much rice and not enough fish. 

I have had good experiences at Mikado in the past, but this wasn't one of them.

Horrible horrible horrible. The entree was very small that I finished less than 5 minutes!

We sat outside and there was a fruit fly in my sisters drink. We told the server and her response was "well you are sitting outside." She did not apologize at all or offer her a new drink. The service was horrible. Will not come again

Good place to drink cheap beer and listen to the locals talk about the good old days when it was legal to beat your wife. They have ample boat parking which is nice. Bartenders are very willing and NASCAR is always on the tube. If you do go please tip the help, cause shit man, their job sucks.

These donuts looked delicious at first but once I tried one then I realized how stale they were with no filling in the headlight donut! this place definitely needs to be updated on management to let such nasty food go out the window, My local dunkin I appreciate more since this visit

Idk why but this location is just terrible. The food is often inedible. Today I got a breakfast sandwich for myself, and bagel minis for my son which were both burnt to a crisp. Also, got some hash browns that tasted like they were fried in grease that has never been changed. I won't be coming back to this location.

Glass Water bottle had black mold at bottom. We didn't notice til we had drank a glass. :-( 
Next glass bottle had a chip at top. Wth? Our order was wrong. Been customers  since it opened.
Not the first issue with service. 
Can the owner pls read this. My lunch and future visits were ruined after the moldy water bottle.

extremely average ramen! kind of bland, and they didn't even give us an egg in our ramen, which is mentioned to be included with any bowl. server was very inattentive and kind of careless. atmosphere was super weird with random new orleans jazz that went on and off randomly. lol

I have never had a more thorough exam in my life. So very nice & completely professional. The doctor went the extra mile to make sure I was going to have the right prescription. She answered all my questions & explained everything. I heartily recommend this office. You should not even think about going anywhere else.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great, homestyle diner in the seedy part of Tampa, the menu make up for the location featuring a wide variety of American-belovéd breakfast items influenced by the Hispanic culture of Tampa, the service here is great and the coffee is always hot, earning the five star review.

Great Sushi Restaurant! Excellent Prices for Dinner and Lunch Specials!

Great Service, Staff was very helpful, Sushi Chefs were great! Everything was delicious! Would Recommend to Sushi Lovers!

I would return to this sushi restaurant the next I am in the mood for Sushi.

they do not answer their store phone and it's soooo annoying!!!!!! i called the store almost 20 times to speak with the manager and even waited until better hours to call and they still never answered!!! what kind of store in 2020 does not answer their phone !?

I went to Feline Cat Clinic and it was an amazing experience. If you're having trouble with Sabino Veterinarian Care seeing your cat, you might try Feline Cat Clinic, off Campbell. Dr. UpChurch is amazing with cats. She had no trouble at all with my boy. Got a full panel of bloodwork. No medication needed. 100% difference.

This bank sucks!!! They gave me such a hard time and im a private bank wells fargo customer i should not have too go threw all of this to get a cashiers check.. and the indian lady is a bitch and the white lady!! This location is horrible!!! Spare your time!!!

Dropped in to have a slice and try it out, I had a plain cheese slice, I didn't like it at all.

Nu Yalk Pizza is WAY Better. Smiling with Hope Pizza is also good but not as good as Nu Yalk.  If you want a GOOD slice of pizza go to Nu Yalk Pizza in south Reno by Winco.

We have tried so many ice cream spots since moving to New Orleans. This place is phenomenal. The ice cream was fresh, the flavors were unique and oh so tasty...my taste buds are singing me praises! The superb customer service was an added bonus. Our kids had a blast!

After watching Thrive from a distance I finally took the plunge and signed on to work out with Alissa Higgins.  Besides being totally adorable she's an awesome trainer.  The constant variation in work out makes it challenging and fun.   If you're looking to turn up the volume on your work out routine it's money well spent.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I don't care what authentic Chinese food is. Everything here is awesome. Best General's Chicken in the World. In fact, I often daydream that it's raining General Tso's from Chef Chun. And I'm frolicking through a meadow catching pieces with a butterfly net. A tad pricey for the portions, but...Great place!

I am from NYC. And believe me this is as good as any place on the upper east side in NYC. Big fat egg rolls fried to perfection. Fried dumplings awesome. Delicious moo shoo pork!! And house special fried rice prepared to perfection. Do not listen to any other review. The only place better is Chinatown.

This McDonalds sucks without relent.  Two basic rules of the franchise 1) deliver hot food and 2) have the food taste good.  These Ronald McDonalds didn't just give me food that was not hot, it was actually cold, like refrigerator cold.  Wtf.  Also their soda seems to be run through the toilet.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Jim rocks 
Chris rocks too
This is the best bar !

We are superfans because they have all of the best beer, and kickass tunes, and pretzels!!!

You must come and see for yourself! 

If you love good beers - not crap beer- you will be so happy with the selection

Great atmosphere 

Clean bathrooms

Abruzzi's has been my go-to place for so many years now. They are the only place that cares about quality food. . I own a business in the city, everybody knows if you don't return the incorrect food anybody can call and do a scam. Sounds like 2/7/20 post just needed some free fries. Best pizza in town!

I just brought my cat Oreo here for the second time today. My only regret is that I did not find them sooner! They are wonderful! Dr. Connelly took care of my cat Oreo, and for the second time, was absolutely wonderful! Very caring and knowledge. The front desk girls are also awesome. If you own a cat, this is the place to go!

I will say this is one of the BEST doughnut places I have seen in a while! They have quite a plethora of doughnuts and wild ideas! Its not meant for someone on a diet ill say that, but its great to check out their doughnuts and try them! You wont regret it!

Without a doubt the best mechanic in town! Eric and his team are honest, efficient and extremely fair with prices. My family will only take our cars to Gulfport Garage and refer him to everyone we know. They get the job done right to ensure you're safely on your way.

The hostess greeted us warmly, but the waiter treated us so cold that he completely ruined the dinner. When we ask him questioned about the rolls, he answered with unmistakable contempt, very short and quick answer, no smile, aloof. We were shocked. We won't come back.

We love coming to Rodes. Their brunch is amazing and the bottomless mimosas make the day. All of their food is great. When you go, you have to ask for Andy. He is their best server. He is so energetic and makes sure you have the best experience. Every time we go we make sure to ask for him!

Double Knot is wonderful, so when I saw this spot I had to try. Sushi rolls are tiny and overpriced. Not freshly made. I ordered spicy tuna rolls and received dried out tuna with no spicy sauce. The spicy cucumbers leave much to be desired. Better off elsewhere!

I would never take my car for work here again, they lied about repairs as I was getting 2nd opinion about my alignment, they also wanted to charge me 4 times as much as it normally should. The staff was also very rude so I would avoid this place all together.

From the friendly, attentive, knowledgable wait staff to the memorable meals, this is not a place to miss!  The filet was tender and perfect. The pasta dish was perfectly al dente.  The evening ended with the perfect tiramisu.  A completely enjoyable evening!

This store is awesome! Great staff! Managers are very nice and professional and know how customer service works. There had been a few bad apples working there but for the most part this store is great! The coffee has a way better taste than the competitor and the donuts are amazing! The rewards program is better than Starbucks too.

We are Sushi connoisseurs we've tried every Sushi restaurant in the Tampa Bay area we always try the new restaurants this is by far the best Sushi restaurant in Tampa Bay, we had the Black Dragon.Roll, Sweet Mango Roll , Volcano Roll and the Dynamite Roll,

Dare I say this is the best restaurant on planet earth.  No number of Michelin stars can adequately encompass the experience.  For course number one, I'd recommend two monster margaritas.  Then escape out of the bathroom window before course number two arrives.

Stopped in for a coffee and burger.  Excellent manager on duty.  My coffee needed to brew and she kept me updated on when it would be ready.  I have been to many fast food chains and McDonald's usually never disappoints.  Would have been five stars but my McDouble's bun was a little over toasted!  Keep up the good work!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is one of Santa Barbara best locations for a complete hair saloon.  It comes highly recommended.  The folks are friendly and hair artists.  They will turn your hair into a master piece.  My hair has never looked better.  Jason is a true artist. MAKE SURE TO GIVE THEM A TRY, YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED.

This is my local neighborhood bar and I love this place. The new manager is super welcoming and gets to know all of his regular bar goers and even the people who just stop in. I love that they added live music some nights which is great. Absolutely love this place.

You like burgers, right? You like toppings? Choices? Good fries? Not fast food fries, I'm talking about GOOD fries. 5 guys type of thing, I mean. You need Cheeburger Langhorne. Good service, friendly faces, good times. They do it like no one else. Good for everyone, even vegetarians. Delicious stuff, and lots of fun.

This place is absolutely fabulous. It's hidden and descrete. The service is amazing, and the food is to die for! I had the filet mignon with the garlic and butter sauce and steamed spinach...The best I've ever had, ever! This place should be a 7 star restauraunt. Will be back for sure.

Had a great experience from start to finish. We were sat at our table quick and courteous, our siracha bacon appetizer was amazing. I had the fish special and my husband had the meat special, both were outstanding! Throw that on top of great Service and Botto's becomes an instant favorite.

Love Parkway Cleaners. Always satisfied with their service. Staff is friendly and attentive, you never have to wait long to get checked in. My clothes are always ready for pick up at the stated time. I have sent rugs and comforters there as well. Nice job!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I really wish that there was a Dunkin Donuts in the Puyallup/Graham area! Sad that they got scared out of the Northwest and California when Krispy Kreame came to the area, love they're donuts! But they're advertising really annoys me saying "America runs on Dunkin when there not in the 4 states I mention!

The hotel is located on the bay and offers beautiful views. The rate was reasonable and the staff were very friendly. We enjoyed our stay and the restaurant had a great selection. Our meal was delicious and had a great presentation. When we come back this way the Bay Harbour will be our first choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great place to get an eye exam! Love that they are open seven days a week so it's very convenient for those who work during the week and are also open very late. The doctor is also very good and they have a good selection on frames! Will defintatly keep going there!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I absolutely love this place! Make an appointment they have so many regulars! I get my pink and white gel nails there. They are always on point. I feel so pretty with these nails and I get compliments even when they been done for 3 weeks. Sonny doesn't talk much but he is a perfectionist! I will not go anywhere else EVER!

Awesome food, great deal... Love this place! The all you can eat sushi has a lot of choices and is made to order. Great atmosphere, friendly staff and I really love the guava candies they give you on the way out. I've never tried the hibachi, but Im sure its just as good. This place is always reasonably busy - so you know its good!

Definitely the best Mexican joint in town! Top shelf margaritas are the highlight of this place. Pretty much had everything on the menu here, never have I been unsatisfied. Prices are reasonable food is extraordinary. But back to the margaritas, they are Godly!

From the fabulous drink mixer menu to the amazing meal and wonderful service, our dinner could not have been better! The calamari appetizer was delicious (though a little bit tough). The strip steak was perfectly seasoned and cooked. HIGHLY recommend dinner here!

This is the best veterinary veterinary hospital I've ever had. From the staff at the desk to the veterinary tech/nurse to the vet themselves. Totally professional, caring experts in animal care, affordable. I have five cats and am making them my veterinary care for all five

This is a great place to stay! Rooms recently renovated.  Staff are friendly and very helpful.  I come here to this area several times a year and have stayed here several times!   Always very happy with my stay!  Thank you!  Bob Evans is next door which makes getting meals quite easy for my grandson and me!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The thing I really love about this Wendy's is that they hire special people for their entire staff you might wait a little longer you might have cold fries you might not get the right thing you ordered and they might not know what tartar sauce is but they're special so that's great

This is the thrid time I have made a review and some how they are
removed.  Im sure this isn't the owner removing it. So if people can
 remove reviews, is this (real People.Real Reviews) I think I will use
the A list for now. And get the real deal. Don't take my word for it look
up Red's. on A-list See who are the Pro's

I have eaten here about 5 times and every time the food has been delicious, fresh and overall fantastic! I can't say enough about it. The service is wonderful and quick. It is a hidden gem in Yardley and they have great lunches as well as dinners. Dining outside is also a nice feature.  It's worth your while to go!

The quality of food is unmatched in Reno. This is our new favorite spot, we have tried nearly everything on the menu and it is all extraordinary. The wait staff are helpful and sweet! Additional seating just outside the restaurant or in the wine bar next door. I vote this place best of Reno'

It was an amazing experience. Best experience I have ever had with a car rental company. I always leave at least an hour leeway time to pick up or drop off a car, but even though it was off airport, it only took about 15 minutes to get picked up dropped off, serviced at the counter and in the car. AMAZING !!!!

Absolutely incredible! The service is top notch. Our waiters were on top of their game, knowledgeable and could answer our questions with perfect description. The food was incredible and prepared to absolute perfection. Do yourself a favor, make reservations and do not miss out on this St. Louis jewel.

The Bashful Bandit is safer than Safeway grocery stores as well as safer than driving on Tucson's streets.
The Bashful Bandit has hosted many charity events and contributes much to Tucson's culture.
Good food on weekends and probably the safest place in Tucson for an unescorted woman.

Great Mexican food. Great prices. Huge portions. Extensive menu. Fresh, clean, attractive decor. We were amazed by this new Mexican restaurant. They've been open for two weeks today. All food made from scratch fresh twice a day. We were stuffed and ate less than half of our order! We have a new favorite Mexican restaurant.

The store has moved to 490 N broad street-Suite 3.
The food is still nauseating and horrible!!!!! The chief got the COVID but still work in the kitchen!!!!! So horrible restaurant!
The Hong Kong owner is against gay, often sneered LGBT and black people in chinese!!!!!!!!!!!!

Not sure why other reviews are so low. The place is really clean and tidy, very nice staff and quick service. Delicious breakfast burritos, just like the east side location. I had the chorizo, potato and egg breakfast burrito, and was able to get salsa verde on request. Great prices! You can't ho wrong here

This is a great place! The manager Bart is always there and keeps the gym very clean and the machines/equipment in good shape. This location is much better than the Thompson rd location. The 24/7 option is very convenient and the bathrooms with showers is really nice as well. Thank you Bart!

text: The best sushi spot in all of PA.. a true hidden gem...I hesitated to give a great review because of selfish reasons but can I tell you that no matter what you order you will not be disappointed! Take out or eat-in the food is always beautifully represented..I LOVE THIS PLACE oh the prices are great to...

If you want good food and excellent service come to this McDonalds. You can tell that the staff here actually cares and tries to get orders out as quickly as possible even when they are slammed. I would recommend trying their new burger the smokehouse burger.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: BEST SUSHI I HAVE EVER HAD. I am not a picky person, but I would say this is by far the best sushi. They keep the restaurant VERY clean and the service is the best I've ever come by. I would recommend this place to anyone who loves sushi. I also have eaten here like 4 times in a month. It's just that good people.

I stopped in to get my 30 day supply of food and water and other supply's . The place was clean inside and outside of Fry's and the staff were friendly . Every one should get there 30 day supply of food and water. Because of the supply chain and the debt ceiling and the Goverment shut down on 12/03/2021.

Virginia, who was working the drive through today, is probably the best employee that they could ever ask for on the customer service end. Unbelievably sweet. On top of that, she knew the name of the person in front of me and knew what they would be ordering before they ordered it. She just had it ready. Never let go of her.

Hands down, best pizza in Tampa!!!! Ingredients are fresh and made to order. I had the prosciutto and arugula pizza and it came out piping hot, which is the first thing I look for. Great customer service as well!!! If you are looking for fresh handmade pizza, Platts is the place for you.

IBD is a must if you are South of Nashville! We all ordered 12 donuts and PSLs - they were the perfect morning treat! We highly recommend the glazed!   The staff make you feel like an old friend when you're here and you will feel like the heart of life is good! Don't miss out on this adorable shop! It's a pleasure!

Vetture's is THE best in town!!  Not only is the food authentic and amazing, the owners and staff are so wonderful! I wish I could give more 5 stars! You really must go!!  Let them make you one of their specialty pizzas or sandwiches, you will not be disappointed!

They have a very solid beer selection here touting several microbrews and specialty cocktails, a big plus for this "middle of nowhere" bar and restaurant.  Many of the visitors to Nockamixon State Park should find this appealing if they stop in for a cocktail.

The service was so wonderful. Everyone at the counter is pleasant and happy to assist you. I had my reservation set and the car was already in the parking spot waiting for me to pick it. The employees offered me directions and ask if I needed any help getting to my vehicle. Such great service.

I'm normally on time for all my eye appointments but I recently moved so I had a hard time getting here. But despite the fact of me being 15 minutes late the staff still took extra care of me and helped me with choosing my contacts as well as some really cool Gucci frames!
I Love Eye Encounters!  P.S. I'll be on time next time lol
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Ordered large drink. Only $1. I go to McDonalds often first time here. It's the best one I've been to. Though I had to clean off the table myself because my table was dirty. Deserves the review I gave it. BEST PLACE EVER. I recommend you try this place it's amazing.

text: Wow this club is AWESOME!! They just had a change in ownership and you can tell that the new owners take pride in their business. text: I have to say I absolutely love the new look at the rosebud, formally Mambu. The wine is exquisite, service exceptional, calamari amazing, and the entrees me and my fiancé ordered were the best in town. We will be back and if your looking for a great atmosphere with great food I suggest you stop in.

I can't say enough about this wonderful management! Such kind people, who actually care about the people who live here. The office staff is sweet, friendly and professional!! Not to mention fast. Clean and well maintained grounds, pet friendly and great, upgraded apartments. I love it and recommend it to anyone!!

Best barber shop in Smyrna, no doubt about it. All of the barbers are super nice and they all know what they're doing in there. I have really thin hair so I always have a hard time getting the right fade I want. Ever since I've been coming here it's been perfect. Never had any complaints on my cuts.

So excited to move into the Girard. The website sold me right off the bat showing how the building has so much greenery and the super cute dance video was a nice touch. Working with the Greystar team on picking out my apartment home just sealed the deal. If you are looking for luxury in Phily, this is the spot.

After reading these reviews and seeing exactly HOW many times this company will be sued... I'm staying FAR FAR FAR away from them.. I'll make sure my friends and family do the same... Nice story about them on a few Facebook pages today... They'll be out of here soon.... We won't miss them at all ;)

This Enterprise Rent-A-Car location does an excellent job with customer service, employee courtesy and competence!  :)  From pick-up to check-out to check-in to drop-off, we had no complaints.  All employees were helpful and friendly!  :]  Keep up the good work, Enterprise Employees!  :D

The guys inside are friendly and the store is clean and well-stocked.

I appreciate that they don't try to make you wear a mask.  They understand the mask mandate is not a law, and contradicts the Nuremberg Code and CA Civil Code 51. Further, why wear something that doesn't work??

Thank you Mesa Liquor for helping restore sanity!

This is by far the best frozen yogurt shop I have been to. The owners couldn't have been more welcoming. The yogurt was great quality and their topping selections were very good. No corners were cut! Prices were below typical yogurt shops. I highly recommend.

I live in Dallas and I've never been to Woodlands (or Florida), but Dr. Kitz used to practice in Dallas and I remember her very well because I've had lots of pets and lots of vets and Dr. Kitz is the ONLY smart one I have ever had thus far, and it's been several years since she left here.

The food is good , if u have hours to wait for it !  They are Always understaffed like they aren't expecting customers I guess ‼ Anything u need , u have to ask for because the waiters are too busy to ask u what u want . I've been here several times and it's the worst of All the Sahms around ‼

Your represent the voice of America.  Good for you.  My son says you have the best chicken tenders in town and I can always go for a good ole Bud bud.  God bless you and God bless America.  (run some promotions right now... good time to do that... no jingles just 1/2 off appetizers would be a good one)

Relatively new Chinese restaurant in my neighborhood...got a flyer on my door so decided to try their takeout service. I ordered online, which was quick and easy...reasonable 5.00 delivery charge. 

The food arrived in about 45 minutes...it was piping hot, well packaged and VERY tasty...I definitely will be using them again!

Will always choose dunkin over Starbucks! The drive-thru is always fast and efficient, they've never messed up my order and the donuts always taste fresh no matter what time you get them. The coffee they have is always fresh as well and the inside is clean and inviting.

Best sushi I've ever had. Amazing fish. They give so much fish with nigiri, more than I've ever seen. They always give delicious miso soup. The seaweed salad is scrumptious and so is their seafood udon noodle soup. They have half priced rolls every day and every sushi roll tastes amazing. Friendly staff and great service.

Food was outstanding and the employees are so respectful. Pizza and Burgers are absolutely incredible and I could not recommend them any more to anyone in the area. They have an amazing selection of food in the deli and in general provide an amazing experience.

Great Mani/ Pedi. hot stone/lotion massage on legs and it was cheaper than my normal spot! Jimmy is the best, he will take care of you. went above and beyond expectations. He let me in when they were closing, took his time and stay an hour after it closed.

Avion was the 3rd place I checked out. The minute I walked in I was greeted by Ana with a big smile. She was very informative and listened to what I was looking for. All the paperwork was done with no problem as well. The apartment was really nice and the entire complex was clean. I give them 5 starts all day

The BEST Italian Restaurant in Philly! The food is delicioussssss! Beside the food the service is also great and very friendly! I highly recommend it for big parties, family dinners or just a to go place with your friends. The prices are pretty cheap for the food and service they provide! I never get disappointed of that place!

This place is running a whore house , you can pay the receptionist at the front desk 53.00 cash no credit card needed or Id required for a room , she pockets the money and you have a room for the hour , also the manager is on this deal also just ask for Rodger
