text: If you LOVE sushi this is the place for you. The  waiters were very kind. Food was good, would come again. I quote my dad " best sushi bar in Boise".  They have made this restaurant beautiful.  Hope you come to this restaurant. They also have green tea ice cream and fried ice cream.

It has been a year that I moved out here to Runnemede. Luigi's is the first pizza joint I tried and I am still afraid to try any other place haha!! Staff is super friendly every time I call to place an order. Super accommodating! You need to try Luigi's Pizza and Family Restaurant of Runnemede

This place is a must place to go and get a burrito or taco , the flavor just hit your mouth differently, I would 100% recommend this amazing place. There staff is nice, clean , and always there if you need help finding out what's good. 

Keep up the good work fitos!

I got the pink postcard from "National Vehicle Protection Services" urging "Immediate Response Requested" warning that my factory warrantee expires, and I should call with my car's VIN number and exact miles. Interesting, since I have not owned a car in over ten years!

Beware!

Our experience at this Enterprise has been the best rental car experience we've had! No hassle, quick service and super friendly and helpful! Not only do they pick you up to get your car they will take you home after you drop it! HIGHLY recommend this location!!

I intended to use the drive through. But they had it blocked off. I almost left but decided too get out car. The cashier Anthony was great. He was very much on point and he spoke when I arrived, and spoke just before I left. 

The inside was very clean as well. No complaints

Great tasting donuts! The different types of donuts they have were amazing! Dino sprinkles! Fruity pebble sprinkles, bacon donuts! Prices were great and the staff were all so sweet and patient with us while our toddlers picked out their donuts they wanted!

By far, Mediterraneo has the BEST PIZZA in the Malvern, Frazer, West Chester & Exton area.       The owner is a New Yorker and knows how make a good NY style thin crust pizza.     I can guarantee you that if you try 1 pizza from this place you will not go anywhere else.    It's a slice of NY right here on Route 30!

I went to this Salon and it was wonderful!  My stylist was Lacey!.  She was a sweet girl and really knows what she is doing.  She did EXACTLY what I had envisioned and more!!!  I have not felt this good about my hair in ages!!  I highly recommend this salon and Lacey.  I will definitely be going back!  Thank you so much, Lacey!!

Friendly helpful staff. All of the ladies are so pleasant! Dr. Itabiyi is the best....very kind, courteous and he explains everything he is doing. I don't know where the negative reviews are coming from. Must be old reviews from when the staff was different.

text:
They have iPads in the waiting area along with free chargers (USB and AC) where you can order an overpriced drink and it magically appears in under 10 minutes. Perfect!

I guess they need a better way to figure out which iPad placed the order because I needed to let the waitress know the drink was mine when she came by.

Amazing laundromat!  Very friendly staff. Reasonably priced.  Yes some machines are out of order, but stuff breaks so people need to understand thats why there is a variety of washer/dryers. I will definitely be coming back. A bonus is that they will do your laundry for you for a charge!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Bottom line awesome service with a smile and employees are always looking for the best deal for you every time. Been there about 3 times in the last month and will be going back in the next 2 weeks because of the service. Hope this helps you decide on renting a car.

Wonderful salon! The staff and my stylist Marie are professional and take great pride and care in keeping their clients' hair healthy and beautiful. This is the best salon I've visited in Missouri and the 3 other states I've l lived in. You should definitely try it out.

This hotel was absolutely the best place to get a great nights sleep and wake up to fabulous grounds with the best customer service! There is a boutique hotel in Carmel that should sent its staff to this Marriott to shadow the employees to mirror the Marriott staff! Bravo Marriott!

text: I reckon this is the greatest restaurant on earth. Come here all the time and am never disappointed! Always a great meal, big portions, and the staff makes you feel like part of the family! And the live music is always a treat, and they're super nice guys.

Don't believe everything you read on here about bad food. I've eaten here over 10x's and this place is legit! The food is excellent and the service has always been good. The best chori pollo I've had! I have no idea what some of the others on here are talking about. Take a chance because it's worth it!

BEST PLACE IN TOWN!!! everything we ordered was AMAZING! street corn, shrimp tacos, baja tacos, and churros were incredible!!! Drinks were insanely good, I recommend the margaritas and paloma :D employees were SO friendly and welcoming from the start, our waiter was Kevin, he's AMAZING!!!! 5 STARS!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

Great friendly service & would recommend this Dunkin better than others while visiting PA
Coffee piping Hot Fresh, clean well maintained. 
Quick and friendly courteous service@drive thru! 
Thank God No Toxic Styrofoam cups! 
Awesome a Senior discount 10% a plus!

Absolutely love this place.  Have been coming here for the last 15 years and have never been disappointed.  Great job on both my nails and my tootsies.  I can show Quinn pictures of nail art and she does her absolute best and again never have I been disappointed.

Every time I come here I come there with excellent delight. It's so wonderful here I feel so happy inside every time I order. Because of the great customer service that they provide at this sushi spot. I'll deathly come back with the whole family next time I come.

This place is horrible! Bad service, Bad food, Bad vibe.  The "server" recommended Pinot Noir when I asked for a bold, red wine.  We had 4 dishes and all of them were gross. Even the bread was horrible. Extremely overpriced- This place is rachet!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This has to be the best Chinese restaurant in the USA. The food is fresh and amazing. I feel that they make the food with love. You can tell that they love working there.  I love the chicken broccoli, general tso and egg rolls. The service staff is very friendly. They are so nice. A great fast food Chinese place.

Great Salon! Awesome space with convenient parking right in Doylestown. Gaby the owner cut and colored my hair exactly how I wanted it. Very friendly staff.  and reasonably priced services, which is always a plus. I noticed they also do nails there as well!

Great place for your loved ones.  Very caring ladies that know how you make your pet comfortable.  My dog came in all scared shaking and then the girls took him did something with him to make him feel comfortable like home. I was amazed. 
Great doctor and great front desk. 
Super clean and smells good. 
And the prices are good

Wanting something other than a chain restaurant, craving home-cooking, then this is the place! Hand-cut and battered onion rings and zucchini! YUM! Best fried chicken, EVER! They have salads, burgers, seafood, steaks. Kids love the mini-corn dogs and their spaghetti. A must stop along I-44. Very reasonably priced.

Went 3 times . Each time at drive thru the man said the cash register doesn't work. I went to Arby's next door and see the drive thru magically working. Hmmm made me wonder for while until I realized each time was same person not choosing to serve me because of my white skin color. Racism certainly exists

Plain HORRIBLE. This pizza was burnt, hard, and had absolutely no taste! I ordered a pepperoni and sausage pizza and it was the worst pizza I've ever had. I also ordered buffalo chicken wings and they were uncooked and super nasty. They tasted like they were refrigerated and then heated up by how plain they were. Disappointed!

Josh and the rest of the staff are all very helpful and do a great job at running the community. The area is safe, place is well kept, and everyone is friendly. It's been nothing but great times here at Covington since moving in earlier this year. Definitely recommend looking into living here!

Thank you McDonalds! I was having trouble finding a local McDonalds to help me with hot boxed coffee, I was able to get in touch with Donna from Christian foods who took care of my boxed coffee needs! McDonalds was super friendly and had everything ready to go for me.

I like that I can leave my clothes early before going to work and pick them up on my way back on the same day. Clothes are always ready.

text: Absolutely amazing! I have one very anxious dog and one that loves anyone that will pet her and both adore every staff member here! The staff is very nice and never over charge/make you pay for anything that your pets don't absolutely need. I will never go to another pet clinic and recommend this place time and time again!

Paid $20 For A Shrimp And Oyster Po Boy With Onion Rings And It Was Horrible! I Only Had Two Shrimp And Three Oysters In It And Most Of It Was Bread! Waste Of My Money And I Def Wont Be Back. Wait 20 Minutes And Wasted 20 Bucks For A Po Boy That Wasnt Overstuffed Like They Advertised!

This is by far my favorite place to go for groceries!! It is open 24 hours,very clean, and the staff is very nice!! I come here every Saturday morning! Only slight issue I have is the lines can sometimes get too long, not enough cashiers. A small infraction for a place so great!!!

Today was my first visit at Gloss Nail Studio, and it won't be my last! Christian did a perfect job on my nails! She was so nice and friendly  The shop is beautifully decorated and very clean. I'm so happy I found this nail studio. If you're looking for a great place to have your nails done,look no further, this is the place!

My band's van broke down and we were stranded in Boise. BUT RUDYs SAVED US!!! the owner bill went out of his way to stay late and help us and not only that WAS COMPLETELY HONEST AND AFFORDABLE. what a rare treat in a horrible situation. Go to RUDYs the cowabunga babes promise a good deal.

My friend and I were here for the weekend. Right out of the gate Champ helped us when it came to getting out begs to our room and was super nice. We stayed here last year but Champ made things a little easier and a lot better. Due to the fact he was easy to talk, great personally and out going.

text:
This is the most delightful grocery store in the area to shop.  The employees are friendly and MOST helpful, the aisles are wide, the store is very clean and bright - there is nothing bad to say about this store!  I shop here all the time.  The prices are the lowest in the area.

~Cindy!  :)

Let the good times and the best flavors roll! If you haven't tried rolled ice cream let this be the best introduction to your pallet! If you love rolled ice cream and haven't been, what are you waiting for?! The atmosphere is family oriented, great staff, clean and the prices, Magnifique!

Amazing.  The food is always consistently great.  Our go to pizza place and everyone who has had it has nothing but great things to say about it! Owners are also super friendly.  Visited during the pandemic and really appreciate how serious they are taking the social distancing efforts.

I read the reviews of this DD and was hesitant on stopping by here but my experience was fantastic! Enough for me to write a review and I never take the time to write reviews. The drive thru staff was incredibly kind and respectful. My coffee was perfect and the donuts were fresh. Definitely one of the best DD I've been thru.

Best food in town!!! The porkette sandwich and cheesesteaks are out of this world!! And for dinner my favorite is the Sunday gravy!! Everything is so fresh and delicious! They certainly don't skimp on portion size either.  And when you go don't forget to order the butter cake!!!

My daughter found this place and they are the BEST ever. Honest! Today they quoted $418 on a repair and then charged only $367 saying they over bid it!!!!! Was quoted $600 for the same repair by another shop. Same thing with other repairs, they are honest and do a great job!!!! I want everyone to know how wonderful this shop is!!!!

One of the best shops .. nice staff 
They always provide me with tips that helps me keep my car in a good condition.. if there's something need to be fixed or added they always write it down on a receipt which is very helpful , i always change my oil there and always will . 
Thanks guys for such service, keep it up

text: Hands down a great place to grab dinner or a drink. Ok, we grab carry out a lot too. Onion rings are homemade - and are killer! Great salads and wraps - everything is great. We've never had anything that wasn't yummy - definitely can't go wrong eating here.

This restaurant gets it right!  It is the place for great food, nice ambiance, fair pricing, and generous portions.  For great Chinese food,  this is the best place in St. Louis.   Hunan Peking on Telegraph, should not to be confused with other restaurants with the same name.  This management has only one location.  Don't miss out!

Everything was fantastic! We had the lobster bisque soup, pizza, caprese salad and chicken parmigiana.. The pizza was to die for, best in the area. chicken parmigiana was authentic, the sauce was awesome! Jenna was amazing and very attentive:) will definitely be back!

first time meal. best italian food in 20 yrs. food awesome. chef, best. kept bringing unordered lusheness to the table thruout the meal.its a long drive, but going back. feels like lifelong friends. service was special I telling all my foodies. look out, commin back

Best wings I have ever had.  I would go there more often but the store is 35 minutes away...so I try to make sure it's "on the way" whenever I can.  I can't vouch for the rest of their menu as I have never tried any of their other food and don't see a need to.

This is my favorite Chinese food place I've ever had outside of New York City! All the food I have gotten from there is so good especially the sesame chicken and general tso! 10/10 recommend I have told all of my friends about this place and every single one of them also becomes obsessed with it!

This is as good as Mexican food gets here in Tennessee! My wife and I are from Southern California/Arizona and we know good Mexican food. Come try this new reastaurant, you won't be disappointed.  The staff is knowledgeable and helpful,  take their recommendations!

Watch out other car washes? Robert F was lying about the price quote given to him. He claims  hes a writer and moved here from Los Angeles. How about  telling the truth about the vulgar and abusive language you used on the employees? If you're a writer you should have been more professional at handling the situation.

Worse food ever, $25.00 in the trash after  two bites. If there was any redeeming value it was hot when we got it home.
Never again, the reviews I read recommended this place.
Not sure where those people are use to eating.
Not even the fortune cookies, they were stale

Nina was a really good person but she didn't know what she was doing, she got the price wrong twice. Not sure how you do that when it's a scale. Oh well you should give Nina a raise cause I decided to change my review from a 2 star to a 5 star. This place slaps.

I brought my Ford Edge in for service on new brake booster, Very reasonably priced. My car was clean and they added windshield washer fluid,  How nice was that?!  Recommended service and repairs on my car for future. All my families vehicles will be coming to Tip Top Toys for service.

I must say how amazing Hillary is! She just knows what is right for you and does such an excellent job. She is a very experienced stylist with the most awesome personality. I would definitely recommend Hillary for any color/cut styles! Thank you Hillary and thank you Crush! Loved it. Nina

Make the right decision, go to Dante's. It's pretty much the best and only option. 


Yelp is making me write a longer review, so I'm going to list a few adjectives Dante's is synonymous with: Delicious. Wonderful. Mouth watering. Tasty. Cheesy. Perfect. Orgasmic.

NOT EVEN CLOSE TO AUTHENTIC TACOS! Taco bell is more authentic.. I'm sorry but to me an Authentic mexican restaurant knows what a soft corn tortilla with carna asada onions and cilantro is! Here all they have is American cheese, iceberg lettuce, tomato, soggy, flavorless tacos.. Yuck premixed weak margaritas..

I love it here. The staff is great and always available the and anemeties are beautiful and the community is awesome. The maintenance is always available throughout the day. Neighbors are friendly and the main office is very cozy and clean. The staff is very professional

The first plane to a restaurant here feeling very fresh sushi and other restaurants are not the same taste, and sushi dish is also very beautiful place which I have not seen before again. Services and the environment are good, I feel very comfortable coming to dinner!

Food was great. The employees went above and beyond the call of duty to fulfill my order and make the experience exceptional. The dining area is spotless and has a wonderful atmosphere. My order was delivered with flawless execution and incredible precision.

It feels good to know you have a local restaurant that serves authentic Mexican food with PRIDE!! Service is on point ever time. Soul n home food has me coming back. The food served is just like the great pictures on the menu. Thank you Jalisco's for providing me a home cooked meal and SOME!!

Joseph had a huge storehouse in the middle of "the city." Thanks for the rich dispensing at the perfect time. I had a peaceful visit on Halloween. I'm happy and I hope all people flock to this place. Hospitality is a service. Everything was perfectly arranged. See you in the future. Thanks again.

This is probably the best sushi in south jersey. I eat a lot if sushi when i go to LA and this is as goid as many of those restaurants and a lot mire fairly priced. The fish is always moist and has a fresh shimmer. They have a large menu of creative dishes.

I had the best experience ever with the Lending Team at GNOFCU! They are kind, creative and considerate of their membership!!! I encourage anyone who is eligible to contact Danielle or Quaneisha for their services!!! They won't disappoint you!! I love this CU!!!

I've been too ALOT of barbers and I can tell you that Jason is the real deal. No one has ever even come close to doing fades as well as him. The atmosphere is awesome and the conversations never fall short. Can't recommend HOB enough, you gotta experience it!!

This place was not only delicious but the service was stellar. Our waiter took time out of his day to tell us everything cool going on around town and made our experience so fun and enjoyable. Would recommend this place to anyone! Hot shot was really cool, told me he owned the place and could hook me up anytime!

Excellent customer service! I use this cleaners weekly, and I'm very happy. They take the upmost care with my garments they treat me like a king. I'm very happy. Definitely will recommend this cleaner to my friends. I have been using this cleaner for 5 years
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have an appointment there Wednesday afternoon and it was wonderful. The doctor was very nice and actually talked to me about my eyes. When I was having a difficult choice picking out glasses the lady helped me out. They are all so nice there and make you feel welcomed. If you live in the area I would get your eye care here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I LOVE this place! I always get the very best glasses and the very best help at Modern Eyes Optical! Very stylish glasses and people who really care. They really work with you to make sure you are satisfied (and even help you pick the right frames for your face!) What else would someone want from a business?
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Fortune Cookie is AMAZING! I haven't been disappointed yet. Delicious and authentic Chinese cuisine for a great price? Yes, please! Dining in is clean and casual and delivery is fast and prompt. I suggest the Shrimp Lo Mein and Orange Chicken! Don't forget the Fried Wontons and Hot and Sour Soup! Scrumptious!

Excellent acrylic nails done by Kim herself. She was open to looking at photos I had of nails I liked a recreated a set almost perfectly ! Her technique is excellent, prices are good, the atmosphere in the building is fun, and the experience was excellent. Would recommend for anyone who loves gorgeous nails.

Beautiful property that's extremely well kept. It has tons of amenities that make you not want to ever leave home, especially in a time where most of us are having to work from home. The front office is always welcoming and quick to address any issues that may occur. You can tell they really care about their residents!

Delicious,mouth watering perfect little sushi's. The chef is so sweet, staff so kind, server very generous :)) I don't live anywhere near here but I'd drive 30 mins for Yummy sushi and kind service. I love love love love love this place and it's worth the drive ´･･`

This restaurant was a hidden gem!!! The food was outstanding ..plentiful and the best Mexican I've ever had ! The chicken fajita was excellent and enough for two meals! The taco bowl was fried to perfection and filled up to the top! The guacamole was outstanding with light airy chips! Hidden away in a little strip of stores... YUM

Choosing an apartment can sometimes be as difficult as it is important but the difficulty ends here. Great staff from maintenance to management that really makes the building. Overall, this building beats the competition come see this place and you won't need to tour anywhere else!

Absolutely love coming here! This pizza is amazing and has just the right amount of sauce, cheese, and meat. Not Your Average Joe's reminds me so much of being back in New York that I can't keep from stopping by at least once a week to get some pizza pie! If you're looking for great pie, you've definitely got to stop in!

Literally the best in the city , 
Shrimp eggrolls are bomb  The Crab Rangoon is homemade. House lo mein noodles is my favorite I get mine with no pork of course. Shrimp egg foo yong is chef's kiss  gravy is to die for. Oh the shrimp fried rice is good too. Definitely a 10 out of 10.

Chicken quesadillas is too tasty to resist. Probably one of the best Mexican restaurants I have been to. Enchiladas are juicy and lightly crisp, enjoyed every bite of it. Overall it's a must visit place for people who loves to taste different kinds and best of food.

If you ever had good sushi (not supermarket) then you will be thoroughly devastated. We should have left when we walked in and we were hit with a bad odor. The second clue was that there were hardly any patrons. Save yourself some misery if you really like good sushi. If you like supermarket sushi it might be bearable.

Love the service!!  Very personable as he recognizes me , greets me and says my name . As soon as I come in my shirts are being retrieved. Convenient and accomodates any requests. Great tailor had my pants altered and they were perfect. My dry cleaner for life!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Today we tried Senoritas Mexican Taqueria. We had heard about it around town and finally  had to try it. When me and my family were done we realized we had eaten the best Mexican food we had ever tried. Their tamales were cooked to perfection and there meat was extraordinarily good. You have to try this place!!!!!!

The customer service was incredibly friendly. While I was waiting for the lead driver to park the car and come into the service area, I had a friendly conversation with the woman at the desk. She was incredibly patient and very helpful. Not to mention, our car is in excellent condition and suited well for our road trip!

Great food, great drinks, great service, great atmosphere! What more could you want? Awesome place for a Sunday Funday! And they get sweet bands.  This is a perfect place to come hang out with friends, we come here every week. And Mike, Ellie and Alexa rock behind the tiki bar!

This place is absolutely incredible! It's definitely the best ice cream I've ever had. There's a huge selection of unique and mouth-watering flavors designed by Jeni herself to choose from, and the prices are absolutely reasonable for the quality. I couldn't be happier to have it in the area!

I just wanted to take the time to thank the staff at Montebello at Summit Ridge. We lived in our apartment here for a year and a half and loved it. The grounds were maintained well and the staff was always so helpful and friendly. It was quiet and peaceful. This place is awesome, so thank you again! ~ Carrie Kidder

Our family of 4 girls have been customers of Lonnie's for 8 years and have always had a wonderful experience.  The expert staff is friendly, timely, and have never been a disappointment to us.  We would recommend Lonnie's to anyone wanting a superb manicure or pedicure!

Place is a complete joke!! Scam. Don't trust these people. Tried talking to the supervisor and the customer service rep didn't let me. Arguing on the phone for 20 mins and nothing. Complete scam. Does anyone know where I can get in contact with their supervisor or anyone higher up please let me know.

We came on a Monday around 10:30 and the drive through was really busy but the man on the other side was collected and polite as could be. Our service was fast and Pete(?) (older bald gentleman) was very polite and smiling. It's nice to have good complimentary service like that!

What a gem of a restaurant!  My husband and I went there today for the first time. It did not disappoint! The food was absolutely amazing! Authentic Italian food at its best! The service was equally impressive.  Cannot wait to go back and bring friends and family! 
Molto bene! Delizioso! Grazie, Mannino's!

The food is great here, but the servers are horrible and very rude, I would not come back here again. They need better staff and managers to run this sushi club, but bottom line is this very unpleasant service I ever had to be honest, with there was a 0 rating and I would give them that Forsure.

Brandon greeted us at the door and was soooo nice. It was our first time in. He let us know how everything went here and it was smooth sailing from there. But then we were graced by grace... she is absolutely an angel. She should be a manager. Hands down the best experience in Tampa.

This was a major disappointment. This place was hyped up by some acquaintances. I had chips and salsa to start good not great. Then I had chicken tacos and shrimp tacos NOT GOOD at all. Chicken was bland shrimp had some kick bang bang sauce style but NOT GOOD

Absolute favorite restaurant in Nashville. From the wine list to the dessert. Everything was fantastic! Highly recco the Chicken for Two, and the corn bread. The corn bread is to die for and melts in your mouth. The chicken was cooked to perfection, and the potatoes were yummy and crispy.

I am beyond disappointed with the service I received from this establishment. Not only was my food cold, but the hamburgers were less than half the size of regular McDonald's hamburger. They were like joke hamburgers or something. Is that what you think I am McDonald's??? A joke?????
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Amazing service and an incredible atmosphere! Zach was a fantastic server, very knowledgeable and a pleasure to talk to. If I could give more than 5 stars, I absolutely would. I am beyond satisfied with my experience and look forward to coming back many more times in the future

One of the best burgers I've ever had.  I don't know how they do it. But the burger was perfectly charred on the outside and still medium/medium rare on the inside. It's not anything fancy. But if you're looking for an amazing burger this is the place to go.

Do NOT waste your time or hard-earned dollars on this "Pizzeria"!! They serve very bland pasta, uninspiring pizza, and have a very boring menu.
There are so many other restaurants in Nashville that would be better. Actually, ANY other restaurant would be better! Another Nashville FLOP! 
I give them a year....

Have always been treated great at Dobbs...they get me in and out in a timely fashion.  The things they recommended were things i knew that i was overdue on...and gave me a great price and the work was done perfectly...what a breath of fresh air..save yourself the trouble and just go straight to dobbs so its done right.   J
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The sushi house was the beat sushi my wife and I have ever had. We have eaten at multiple different sushi locations in the Philadelphia area and New Jersey and Sushi House just blew every other place out of the water. We can't recommend this place enough and already are planning our next order.

If you're ever at their east side location, be sure to pick up some of the Chicken Dumpling Paste. It puts the ASS in Casserole. If you find yourself unable to finish it, get a to go box and bring it home. After a couple hours you will have plenty of spackle to fill any old nail holes in your garage.

Omg!! A most! Owner Jim... amazing.  Sweetest man ever! The staff is just as amazing,  Kelli the manager keeps out all together,  Lindsey is always fun.  The food is  outstanding and the beer is cold,  seasonal and a perfect end to your day.  Please visit Jefferson's and give your outlook on your experience

If you want some cold but not too cold goodness, then this is a place you can go to while walking downtown. There were many options of ice cream and toppings to choose from. When I was there this location had excellent customer service. The ice cream here is outstanding! Hope you enjoy this as much as I did!

I have no idea why this subway has such a bad rap! I went in this evening with my kids very skeptical but the man who was working was very friendly and engaging with every customer who came in! Great food and great customer service. We will definitely be back!

So I wake up this morning really really wanting a good sandwich to eat before my tournament so I went to Starbucks and little did I know I was going to get an egg sandwich with a frozen egg on it. I would've turned around to go get a refund but I had already thrown up from the frozen egg have to coach the tournament now

Love the atmosphere, drinks & food.  A great addition to downtown NPR.  I have been in multiple times and have never been disappointed!  Great place to relax with friends and enjoy a great meal!  If you are going with friends for a cocktail make it a social!  Fun place.

I have been using Park Avenue Cleaners for over a year now.  Their service is exceptional and the price is outstanding.  James the owner has trained a customer service orientated staff.  They bend over backwards to make your experience superb.  I highly recommend them.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Complete lack of professionalism and quite frankly, I don't feel that anyone inside this office has any care for animals at all. 
I had to wait over a week for my dogs antibiotics and only received them because of constant follow up on my part.
DO NOT GO HERE.

Awesome! Best pizza in Santa Barbara and all of their other dishes that we tried were delicious. Apparently the owner used to make pizza at a famous Brooklyn pizzeria. He must be the Yoda of gluten because the bread and focaccia they also make in house beats every bakery in town. Go check it out!

This is a hidden gem in the city. The food is spicy and authentic with a suburban charm that is welcoming and clean. Specious dinning environment makes you feel comfortable and the perfect lighting allows you to see the beautiful yet simple presentation. Take a moment out of your evening or day to enjoy this fine restaurant!

The sushi and sashima is of the highest quality.  The raw fish was so fresh it must have been caught the day before.  I really enjoyed the white tuna, yellowtail, and red snapper.  Also, they get very creative with rolls.  Tried rolls I've never heard of and they were delicious

Asked for a whopper and a frosty. Never received them, got something called a "Big Mac" instead and a McFlurry. I photosynthesis the people who go here on a regular basis. Asked to speak to the manger who wasn't even Ronald McDonald. 0/10 would not recommend
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Mr Ricky came to pick us up from our hotel and gave us the what's what of the city! Southern Hospitality at its finest! Mr Lloyd welcomed us at the counter  and added to the experience. The best overall experience I ever had while renting a car. If you're ever in town and need to rent a car, come here!

I have been with Seven Trails for close to 3 years and love it!  The staff is always so helpful & kind.  Maintenance is always checking in to see how things are & if I need anything.  It is in a great location.  We love being close to the park, kiddos school & activities.  It truly is a great community!

The staff was so friendly and the food was prepared so quick and I couldn't wait to get home I literally had to pull over and dig in Lmao that was before I found out that they have FREE DELIVERY!!!!! Now I eat from the at least 3 times a week if you haven't tried their foods I highly recommend it

Such a good barbershop to go and get a fresh chop. Got 4 skilled barbers that will give you a finesse haircut. Your date will be impressed, and it's a guarantee that you will have such a good date night, thanks to the 4 fellas that will be willing to give you the best haircut experience of your life.

absolutely very dissapointing what a dump they couldnt serve the ice cream soda that I use to get many many years ago what a scary place and  will never go back take that article in the post this is a complete dump dont waste your time walking in the door would rather have dog ice cream then velvet freeze

The Vodka Fries might be the best order of french fries i have ever eaten.  They have these roasted tomatoes in there that are amazing.  Lots of sauce, lots of cheese and lots of yum.  Delivery was a little longer than quoted via the online ordering process, that's the only reason it is 4 stars.

Mit Abstand die beste Pizza im Land, wie sie selten in den USA serviert wird. Gute und frische Zutaten, hausgemachter Teig, exzellenter Sugo. Eine Pizza, wie man sie in Italien essen würde. Negroni ist ebenfalls empfehlenswert. Auch das Ambiente überzeugt!

This place is amazing! Scrumptious food and don't get me started on the drinks. The End of Summer Blues-Tini is my favorite.  The staff is always right there to check on you. Some of my favorite things to eat is the Texas Burger, Kentucky Club, Chicken Fejitas and the NOLA ShrimpPlate!! I eat there so often that they know me there.

La señora Española es una grosera y maleducada!! Es una persona que humilla a la gente pobre!! 
La comida es muy mala.. haré campaña para que deje de ir mucha gente a este lugar!! Regresate a tu Barcelona catalana basura!!! 

The Spanish lady is a rude and impolite !!  He is a person who humiliates poor people! The food is awful!!!

Lol, this place is literally the worst. I would not recommended anything but the pizza and then, i would only recommend the meat lovers. 
The past is over priced and tastes like something you can get in a lunch line. Good luck. 
It also took 25 minutes to get the bread.

I order a lot of pizza, and Papa John's is probably my favorite chain so I'm already a fan of the brand. But this was amazing, honestly one of the best pizza's I've had in a while. I'm not a review guy but really impressed. If in town and want a really good pizza give them a call.

I've had many experiences here and I hope for many more. The food is always delicious and unique. The staff is beyond welcoming, knowledgeable, and accommodating. And man, those cocktails, phenomenal! Whether a romantic dinner for two or a group of friends looking for a great meal, this is the place to be.

We have finally found the BEST family restaurant in New Port Richey FL. 
The atmosphere, menu, and staff are Exceptional!
The food is INCREDIBLE, the portions are IMMENSE and the prices are very affordable!! How do they do it?? Don't ask, just enjoy!
Yelp needs more stars to rate the Boulevard!!

went for dinner on 10/28 ordered prince  edward island mussells and linguine. first of all they weren't pei mussells and the amount of linguine wouldn't fill up a 6 year old. They using an Italian name to sell their food but the owner and the cooks aren't italian their indian.  stay away! I will never go back!

Excellent food and service! The cipino special was incredible - a veritable seafood ambrosia! I don't know how they created so many different flavor profiles in one dish. Eddie, the server, was excellent, attentive, and knowledgeable.
Another all-around great experience. A gem hidden in Brandon!!

I completely disagree with the bad reviews.  For me, Pearle Vision in Exton is amazing.  Dr. Lim, Gail, Micki and the rest of the staff have always gone above and beyond.  
In regards to the person upset about not getting their PD, valid complaint and I agree, except this isn't unique to this store or Pearle Vision.

text: I've lived at here for almost 3 years and i absolutely love the building and location! The office staff is extremely helpful, outgoing, and the events are superb. I also appreciate maintenance team and how knowledgeable and prompt they are. Great place to be!
